qe: What is the 'Latent Heat of Vaporization' for water in Joules/kg?
qh: पानी के लिए 'वाष्पीकरण की गुप्त ऊष्मा' जूल/किग्रा में क्या है?
e: Bhaap banne ki latent heat paani ke liye lagbhag 2.26 x 10^6 joule per kilogram hoti hai - yani ek kilogram paani ko uske kvathank par poori bhaap mein badalne ke liye itni urja deni padti hai (bina tapman badhaye). Ye urja paani ke anuon ke beech ke hydrogen bandhan todne mein kharch hoti hai, isliye bhaap banti hai jabki tapman wahi rehta hai. Isi karan paseena (sweat) bhaap ban kar shareer se bahut adhik urja le jaata hai aur humein thanda rakhta hai. 2.26 x 10^3 ya 4.2 x 10^3 jaise aankde yahan sahi nahi hain (4.18 x 10^3 joule/kg/K to paani ki specific heat hai). Exam point: paani ki latent heat of vaporization = 2.26 x 10^6 J/kg; bhaap banane ke liye yahi urja chahiye (isliye paseena thanda karta hai).

qe: Which law states that 'Heat cannot flow from a colder body to a hotter body on its own'?
qh: कौन सा नियम कहता है कि 'ऊष्मा ठंडे से गर्म पिंड की ओर अपने आप नहीं बह सकती'?
o: Clausius Statement of Second Law | द्वितीय नियम का क्लॉसियस कथन
e: Clausius ke anusar doosre niyam ka kathan ye hai ki garmi apne aap (bina bahari kaam ke) thande padarth se garam padarth ki or nahi ja sakti - kyunki ye kriya shuruaati avastha mein hi wapas nahi lautti, isliye ye anutkramya (irreversible) hai. Isi baat se hi refrigerator ya heat pump ka mahatva pata chalta hai: unhe garmi ko thande se garam ki or bhejne ke liye bahar se kaam (compressor ki urja) lagana padta hai. Kelvin-Planck kathan ka sambandh heat engine se hai, par yahi baat 'garmi khud ulti disha mein nahi jaati' ke roop samajhna aasaan hai. Exam point: garmi ka apne aap thande se garam ki or na jaana = Clausius statement of second law; isliye fridge chalaane ke liye kaam (bijli) lagti hai.

qe: What is 'Helmholtz Free Energy' (A) defined as?
qh: 'हेल्महोल्ट्ज़ मुक्त ऊर्जा' (A) को कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
e: Helmholtz free energy (A) ko A = U - TS se likha jaata hai, jahan U aantarik urja, T paramm tapman aur S entropy hai. Ise 'Helmholtz function' ya 'work function' bhi kehte hain kyunki ye batata hai ki sthir tapman-tapman (T) aur aayatan (V) par tantra se kitna kaam nikal sakta hai. Iske ulat Gibbs free energy (G = H - TS) sthir dabav ke liye hoti hai; isliye prashn mein A = U - TS hi sahi jod hai. Enthalpy (H = U + PV) tatha G = H - TS alag state functions hain, unka Helmholtz se seedha matlab nahi. Exam point: Helmholtz free energy A = U - TS hoti hai; ye constant T aur V par upyog hoti hai (isliye ise work function kehte hain).

qe: What is 'Gibbs Free Energy' (G) defined as?
qh: 'गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा' (G) को कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
e: Gibbs free energy (G) ka matlab G = H - TS hota hai - yani enthalpy (H) mein se tapman (T) aur entropy (S) ke gunaank ko ghata diya jaata hai. Ye wahi raashi hai jo sthir dabav tatha sthir tapman par kriya ki svatah-gati (spontaneity) batati hai: agar G ka badlav rin ho to kriya khud chalti hai. Isliye rasayanik abhikarmakon ke nirnay mein yahi samikaran sabse adhik istemal hoti hai. A = U - TS Helmholtz free energy hai aur H = U + PV enthalpy hai, isliye wo dono is paribhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: Gibbs free energy G = H - TS hota hai; iska rin (negative) hona kriya ke svatah hone ka sanket hai.

qe: What is 'Enthalpy' (H) for a system?
qh: किसी निकाय के लिए 'एन्थैल्पी' (H) क्या है?
e: Enthalpy (H) ko H = U + PV ke roop mein paribhashit kiya jaata hai, jahan U aantarik urja, P dabav aur V aayatan hai. Iska matlab ye hai ki sthir dabav par kisi tantra ki kul urja mein us dabav-volume wale hisse ko bhi jod diya jaata hai - isliye jab kriya sthir dabav par hoti hai to heat ka seedha maap enthalpy ka badlav hi ban jaata hai (qh = Delta H). Isi karan rasayanik kriyaon ka 'heat' aam taur par enthalpy se likha jaata hai. A = U - TS, G = H - TS ya U + TS aise roop enthalpy ke nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: enthalpy H = U + PV hoti hai; sthir dabav par heat ka badlav hi enthalpy ka badlav hota hai.

qe: In an 'Adiabatic Process', which of the following remains constant?
qh: 'रुद्धोष्म प्रक्रिया' में निम्नलिखित में से क्या स्थिर रहता है?
e: Adiabatic process ki khaas baat hai ki usme tantra tatha charon-aur ke beech garmi ka aadan-pradan bilkul nahi hota, isliye kul heat Q = 0 ho jaati hai (yani sthir rehti hai). Aise process mein aantarik urja mein badlav kaam ke barabar hota hai (Delta U = w) - isliye gas ko jaldi dabane par tapman badh jaata hai aur failne par ghat jaata hai. Isi karan diesel engine mein hawa ko achaanak dabakar jalane ke liye itna garam kiya jaata hai. Tapman ya aayatan sthir nahi rehta (wo isothermal/tapman tatha isochoric ke liye hota hai), isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: adiabatic process mein heat exchange Q = 0 hota hai; usme Delta U = w hota hai aur tapman badalta hai.

qe: What is the 'Thermal Conductivity' of a 'Perfect Insulator'?
qh: एक 'पूर्ण कुचालक' की 'तापीय चालकता' क्या होती है?
e: Thermal conductivity (ushma chaalakta) batati hai ki koi padarth garmi ko kitni aasaani se aage jane deta hai; perfect insulator (aadarsh non-conductor) wo hota hai jo garmi ko bilkul aage nahi jane deta, isliye uski thermal conductivity ka maan shunya (zero) hota hai. Isi tarah perfect conductor ki conductivity anant (infinite) maani jaati hai. Vyavhar mein thermos flask, bhusa, hara-bhara aur tharmocol aise insulators hain jinki conductivity bahut kam hoti hai. 1, 100 ya infinite jaise aankde adhesive insulator ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: perfect insulator ki thermal conductivity shunya (0) hoti hai; perfect conductor ki infinite maani jaati hai.

qe: Which part of the 'Earth' acts as a giant 'Heat Sink'?
qh: 'पृथ्वी' का कौन सा भाग एक विशाल 'हीट सिंक' के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Samudr (oceans) dharti ke sabse bade 'heat sink' ka kaam karte hain - paani ki specific heat bahut adhik hone ke karan ye dhoop ki bahut si garmi sokh lete hain aur dheere-dheere chhodte hain, isliye samudri kinare ke shehar (jaise Mumbai, Chennai) ke tapman mein utna utar-chadhav nahi hota. Yahi karan hai ki samudr vaayumandal ka tapman tatha monsoon nirbhar karte hain. Vaayumandal tatha bhoomi ka heat capacity kam hota hai, isliye wo itna garmi nahi rokti; aise hi dhruviy (polar) barf bhi pighal kar urja leti hai par wo bhaari bhandar samudra hi hai. Exam point: dharti ka sabse bada heat sink = samudr (oceans), kyunki paani ki specific heat adhik hone se wo bahut garmi sokh lete hain.

qe: What is 'Seebeck Effect' related to?
qh: 'सीबेक प्रभाव' (Seebeck Effect) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Seebeck effect batata hai ki yadi do alag-alag dhaatuon (ya ek dhaatu ke do siron) ke sire jodkar unke siron ke beech tapman ka antar rakha jaaye to paripath (circuit) mein vidyut pravah (current) paida ho jaata hai - isi kriya ko tapa-vidyut (thermoelectricity) kehte hain. Isi siddhant par thermocouple kaam karta hai, jisse bhattiyon ka tapman maapa jaata hai (jaise iron-constantan thermocouple). Iske ulat Peltier effect ulti kriya hai (vidyut se thanda-garam karna) aur Joule effect vidyut se garmi paida karna hai. Exam point: Seebeck effect tapa-vidyut (thermoelectricity) se juda hai - tapman ke antar se vidyut paida hoti hai (thermocouple ka aadhaar).

qe: What happens to 'Density' of most substances when 'Temperature' increases?
qh: 'तापमान' बढ़ने पर अधिकांश पदार्थों के 'घनत्व' का क्या होता है?
e: Adhiktar padarthon ka ghantva (density) tapman badhne par ghat jaata hai, kyunki garm hone se anuon ki gati tatha unke beech ki doori badh jaati hai, isliye wahi dravyaman bade aayatan mein phail jaata hai. Yahi karan hai ki garam hawa upar uthti hai aur garam dinon mein taar (bijli ki lines) lambe ho jaate hain. Paani ek apavaad (exception) hai - wo 4 degree C tak garm hone par sikudta hai aur 4 degree C par sabse ghana hota hai. Isliye 'badhta hai', 'same rehta hai' ya 'pehle shunya phir negative' wale kathan adhiktar padarthon ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: tapman badhne par adhiktar padarthon ka ghanatva ghatta hai (anuo ki doori badhne se); paani 4 degree C par sabse ghana hota hai.

qe: What is 'Absolute Humidity' measured in?
qh: 'निरपेक्ष आर्द्रता' किसमें मापी जाती है?
e: Absolute humidity (nirapeksh aadrata) batati hai ki hawa ke ek ghane metre mein kitne gram jal-vashp (water vapour) maujud hai, isliye iska matrak gram per cubic metre (g/m3) hota hai. Iske ulat relative humidity batati hai ki hawa mein kitni bhaap bhar chuki hai (pratishat mein) - ye tapman par bhi nirbhar karti hai. Isi karan garmi mein relative humidity ghat jaati hai par absolute humidity ka aankda sirf paani ki matara batata hai. g/kg (specific humidity) tatha percent (relative humidity) alag raashiyan hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: absolute humidity ka matrak g/m3 hota hai (hawa ke per ghan metre jal-vashp ke gram), jabki relative humidity pratishat mein hoti hai.

qe: Which gas is used in a 'Gas Thermometer' for measuring extremely high temperatures?
qh: अत्यधिक उच्च तापमान मापने के लिए 'गैस थर्मामीटर' में किस गैस का उपयोग होता है?
e: Gas thermometer mein nitrogen gas ka istemal atyant uchch tapman (bahut zyada degree) maapne ke liye hota hai, kyunki nitrogen nishkriya (inert) hai, usi karan uchch tapman par bhi wo kriya nahi karti aur thermodynamic tapman-paimane ke lagbhag ideal gas ki tarah vyavhaar karti hai. Isi liye constant-volume nitrogen thermometer ko standard tapa-maap ka aadhaar maana jaata hai. Oxygen uchch tapman par dhaatuon se kriya kar sakti hai, hydrogen khud gapak (explosive) hai aur CO2 uchch tapman par toot sakti hai - isliye wo vikalp theek nahi. Exam point: uchch tapman maapne wale gas thermometer mein nitrogen gas istemal hoti hai, kyunki wo inert aur ideal gas ke sabse nazdeek hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Sublimation' temperature of water at very low pressure?
qh: बहुत कम दाब पर पानी का 'ऊर्ध्वपातन' तापमान क्या होता है?
e: Paani ka sublimation (bina pighle seedha bhaap banana) aam dabav par nahi hota, par bahut kam dabav (vacuum) par ye shuniya (0 degree C) se kam tapman par bhi ho jaata hai - kyunki dabav bahut kam hone se paani ka pighalna skip ho jaata hai aur barf seedha bhaap ban jaati hai. Isi karan freeze-drying (lyophilisation) mein khana sukhane ke liye bahut kam dabav istemal kiya jaata hai. Yeh kriya svabhavik vaatavaran mein Himalaya jaise uchch sthalon tatha jala (frost) mein bhi dikhti hai. 100 degree C ya 0 degree C (seedha) aise aankde is khaas avastha ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: bahut kam dabav par paani 0 degree C se kam tapman par bhi sublimation karta hai - isliye freeze-drying sambhav hota hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of the Heat Transfer Coefficient?
qh: ऊष्मा संचरण गुणांक (Heat Transfer Coefficient) का 'SI मात्रक' क्या है?
e: Heat transfer coefficient (ye film coefficient) batata hai ki ek square metre satah ke aar-paar per kelvin tapman-antar par kitni urja prati second jaati hai, isliye iska SI matrak watt per square metre per kelvin (W/m2.K) hota hai. Ise tatha thermal conductivity (k) ko milao na: k ka matrak W/m.K hota hai aur wo padarth ka gun batata hai, jabki heat transfer coefficient satah ke aas-paas ke pravah (convection) ka asar batata hai. Isi liye heat exchanger aur condenser ke design mein iska istemal hota hai. J/kg.K (specific heat ka matrak) ya W/m.K (conductivity ka matrak) yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: heat transfer coefficient ka SI matrak W/m2.K hota hai; ye satah se convection dwara hone wali heat transfer ko batata hai.

qe: Why is 'Silver' the best thermal conductor?
qh: 'चांदी' सबसे अच्छा तापीय चालक क्यों है?
o: High free electron density | उच्च मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉन घनत्व
e: Chandi (silver) sabse achha vidyut tatha garmi ki chaalak isliye hoti hai kyunki uske atom ke bahari kosh mein bahut adhik mukta electron (free electron density lagbhag 5.86 x 10^28 per cubic metre) hote hain - ye electron ushma (heat) ko ek sira se doosre sire tak tezi se pahuncha dete hain. Isi karan sabse achhe chaalak mein silver ke baad copper aur gold aate hain, aur mobile electron ke karan ye chamakdar bhi dikhte hain. Uranium ya plastic ke electron bandh hote hain isliye wo kamzor chaalak hote hain, aur 'adhik ghantva' hi chaalakta ka kaaran nahi hota (sisa ghana hota hai par kharab chaalak hai). Exam point: silver sabse achha garmi ka chaalak hai kyunki usme mukta electron ka ghanatva sabse adhik hota hai.

qe: What is 'Calorie' to 'Joule' conversion factor?
qh: 'कैलोरी' से 'जूल' रूपांतरण कारक क्या है?
e: Kalori (calorie) tatha joule dono ushma (heat) ke maap hain; ek calorie wo urja hai jo 1 gram paani ka tapman 1 degree C badhane ke liye chahiye, aur vaigyanik map ke anusaar 1 cal = 4.184 joule hota hai. Isi karan khaane ki urja 'kaalori' aur SI energy 'joule' mein badalne ke liye 4.184 ka gunaank lagta hai. 4.184, 4.2 ya 1 ka seedha sambandh yaad rakhna zaroori hai, kyunki 1 kilocalorie (khaane wali) lagbhag 4184 joule hoti hai. 1 J, 0.24 J ya 100 J aise aankde is badlav ke nahi hain. Exam point: 1 calorie = 4.184 joule; yahi khaane wali energy (kcal = 4184 J) ka aadhaar hai.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of Ice compared to liquid water?
qh: तरल पानी की तुलना में बर्फ की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या है?
e: Barf (ice) ki specific heat lagbhag 0.5 cal/g per degree C hoti hai, jo drav paani ki 1 cal/g per degree C se lagbhag aadhi hai - yani barf ko garam karne mein paani ke muqable kam urja lagti hai. Yahi karan hai ki barf ka tapman tezi se badhta hai jab tak wo pighalti nahi (isliye barf jaldi pighal jaati hai par pighalne mein urja zyada lagti hai). Usi tarah barf ki latent heat 80 cal/g hoti hai. Thos padarthon ki specific heat aam taur par drav se kam hoti hai, isliye 'barabar', 'dugni' ya 'chau-guni' wale kathan yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: barf ki specific heat drav paani ki lagbhag aadhi (0.5 cal/g degree C) hoti hai; isliye barf ka tapman jaldi badalta hai.

qe: What is the 'Critical Temperature' of Helium?
qh: हीलियम का 'क्रांतिक तापमान' क्या है?
e: Helium ki critical temperature 5.2 kelvin hoti hai - is tapman se neeche hi ise dabav dwara drav (liquid) banaya ja sakta hai; isse upar chahe kitna hi dabav lagaya jaaye, helium drav nahi banegi. Yahi karan hai ki helium 'permanent gas' kaha jaata hai (purane samay mein ise drava nahi kiya ja sakta tha). Isi karan helium ko cryogenic (atyant thande) cooling mein istemal karte hain, aur 4.2 K par ye drav tatha 2.17 K se neeche 'superfluid' (bina shuniyata ka pravah) ban jaati hai. Nitrogen ki critical temperature 126 K hoti hai, isliye wo aasaani se drav hoti hai. Exam point: helium ki critical temperature lagbhag 5.2 K hoti hai - isi liye helium ko permanent gas kehte hain aur ye cryogenic cooling mein kaam aati hai.

qe: In which 'Cycle' is heat added at constant pressure?
qh: किस 'चक्र' (Cycle) में स्थिर दाब पर ऊष्मा जोड़ी जाती है?
e: Diesel cycle mein heat ka aaropan (addition) sthir dabav (constant pressure) par hota hai - engine ke silencer mein pehle hawa ko dabav se garam kiya jaata hai, phir diesel ka chhidkav hota hai jo sthir dabav par jal jaata hai. Iske ulat Otto (petrol) cycle mein heat ka aaropan sthir aayatan par hota hai; isi karan diesel engine ki efficiency same compression ratio par Otto se kam par compression ratio zyada hone se banti hai. Carnot cycle mein to heat isothermal process mein aaropit hoti hai, aur Rankine cycle bhaap engine ke liye hota hai. Exam point: jis cycle mein heat sthir dabav par di jaati hai = Diesel cycle; Otto cycle mein heat sthir aayatan par di jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Stefan's Law' power proportional to if T is absolute temperature?
qh: यदि T परम तापमान है, तो 'स्टीफन का नियम' शक्ति किसके समानुपाती बताता है?
e: Stefan ka niyam kehta hai ki kisi kala padarth (black body) dwara chhodi gayi urja par second uske paramm tapman ki chauthi ghat (T^4) ke samanupati hoti hai - yani tapman dugna karne par nikalti urja solaha (16) guna ho jaati hai. Isi niyam se suraj ka tapman tatha bulb ki garmi ka hisaab lagaya jaata hai (E = sigma x T^4 ke roop mein, sigma Stefan-Boltzmann constant hai). T, T^2 ya T^3 wale sambandh galti hain, kyunki ashrit urja ka bhinnaj (temperature dependence) chauthi ghat wala hi hota hai. Exam point: Stefan ka niyam - chhodi gayi urja paramm tapman ki T^4 ke samanupati hoti hai (tapman dugna to urja 16 guna).

qe: What is the 'Thermal Expansion' of Pyrex glass compared to ordinary glass?
qh: साधारण कांच की तुलना में पायरेक्स कांच का 'तापीय प्रसार' क्या है?
e: Pyrex glass ka thermal expansion (ushma-pasaar) aam glass se bahut kam hota hai kyunki usmein boron oxide (B2O3) ki matara adhik hoti hai - isliye garam hone par wo kam failta hai. Isi karan Pyrex ke patan (vessels) ko achaanak garam ya thanda karne par wo tootte nahi, jabki aam glass mein tapman ka jhatka lagne par darar (crack) aa jaati hai. Isi liye laboratory ke patan, ovenware tatha tube-light ke kaanch mein pyrex jaisa kaanch istemal hota hai. 'Bahut adhik', 'same' ya 'shunya' wale kathan glass ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Pyrex glass ka thermal expansion aam glass se bahut kam hota hai (boron oxide ke karan) - isliye wo tapman ke jhatke se nahi tootta.

qe: What is 'Isentropic Process'?
qh: 'आइसोएन्ट्रोपिक' प्रक्रिया क्या है?
e: Isentropic process wo hai jismein tantra ki entropy (S) sthir rehti hai; adiabatic tatha utkramya (reversible) process mein kyunki heat ka aadan-pradan nahi hota aur koi ashuddhi paida nahi hoti, isliye Delta S = 0 ho jaata hai - aise process ko hi isentropic kehte hain. Isliye adiabatic reversible process ka doosra naam isentropic process hai (jisse bhaap turbine aur compressor ka aadarsh ganit hota hai). Isenthalpic (sthir enthalpy) ya isothermal (sthir tapman) alag process hain, isliye wo vikalp isparibhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: isentropic process mein entropy sthir rehti hai; ye adiabatic reversible process ka hi naam hai (Delta S = 0).

qe: What is 'Latent Heat' of fusion for Silver approximately?
qh: चांदी के पिघलने की 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' लगभग क्या है?
e: Chandi (silver) ki latent heat of fusion lagbhag 25 cal/g (yani 105 joule per gram) hoti hai - itni urja chahiye 1 gram chandi ko uske galaank (961 degree C) par pighlane ke liye. Sone ki 15 cal/g aur sise ki 6 cal/g hoti hai; in aankdon se pata chalta hai ki dhaatuon ki fusion heat aam taur par kam hoti hai (paani ki 80 cal/g ki tulna mein). Isliye dhaatu ko pighlane ke liye jitni urja chahiye, wo uske bandhan (lattice enthalpy) par nirbhar karti hai. 80, 540 ya 1000 jaise aankde chandi ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: chandi ki latent heat of fusion lagbhag 25 cal/g hoti hai - dhaatuon mein ye aankda paani ki 80 cal/g se kam hota hai.

qe: Which property of a gas remains constant in 'Boyle's Law'?
qh: 'बॉयल के नियम' में गैस का कौन सा गुण स्थिर रहता है?
e: Boyle's law kehta hai ki sthir tapman (temperature) par gas ki nishchit matara ka aayatan (volume) dabav ke vyutkram (inverse) anupat hota hai, isliye P1V1 = P2V2 hota hai. Isliye is niyam mein jo cheez sthir rehti hai wo tapman hi hai; dabav tatha aayatan dono ek doosre ke saath badalte hain. Charles ke niyam mein dabav sthir rehta hai aur aayatan-tapman ka sambandh hota hai. Isliye 'dabav', 'aayatan' ya 'gas ke mol' ko is niyam mein sthir maanna galat hota hai. Exam point: Boyle's law mein tapman sthir rehta hai (dabav-guna-aayatan bhi sthir); aayatan tatha dabav ek doosre ke vyutkram badalte hain.

qe: What is 'Heat' measured in 'BTU' (British Thermal Unit) equal to in calories?
qh: 'BTU' में मापी गई 'ऊष्मा' कितनी कैलोरी के बराबर होती है?
e: British Thermal Unit (BTU) ushma ka angrezi maap hai; ek BTU wo urja hai jo 1 pound paani ka tapman 1 degree Fahrenheit badhane ke liye chahiye, aur ye lagbhag 252 calorie (yani 1055 joule) ke barabar hota hai. Isi karan air-conditioner tatha heater ka cooling/heating capacity aaj bhi BTU per hour mein likhi jaati hai (jaise 1 ton AC lagbhag 12000 BTU/hour hota hai). 1000, 4184 ya 100 jaise aankde BTU ke nahi hain - khaas kar 1000 calorie lagbhag 1 khaane wali kaalori hoti hai. Exam point: 1 BTU lagbhag 252 calorie (1055 joule) ke barabar hota hai; AC ki cooling capacity aaj bhi BTU/hour mein likhi jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Triple Point' of Nitrogen?
qh: नाइट्रोजन का 'त्रिक बिंदु' क्या है?
e: Nitrogen ka triple point 63 kelvin (aur 12.5 kPa dabav) hota hai - yani is tapman-dabav par thos, drav tatha gas teeno avasthaayein ek saath sthir rehti hain. Isi karan nitrogen ke phase diagram mein yahi nishchit bindu hota hai jisse pata chalta hai ki kis paristhiti mein drav nitrogen banta hai (tatha kaun se tapman par wo seedha gas banta hai). Nishchit binduon ki tulna karein to paani ka ye aankda 273.16 kelvin ke aas-paas hota hai, isliye nitrogen ke liye aise maan theek nahi baithte. Exam point: nitrogen ka tribindu (triple point) lagbhag 63 K hai; us nishchit tapman-dabav par nitrogen ke teen roop ek saath santulit rehte hain.

qe: What is 'Thermos Flask' designed to minimize?
qh: 'थर्मस फ्लास्क' को किसे कम करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
e: Thermos flask (vacuum flask) teen tarikon se garmi ke pravah ko rokta hai: sabse andar chandi-chadhi deewar (silver coating) radiation ko wapas paravartit kar deti hai, do deewaron ke beech ka khaali (vacuum) bhaag conduction aur convection ko rok deta hai, aur dhakkan (cap) upar se garmi ke bahav ko rokta hai. Isiliye ismein garam paani ghanton garam rehta hai - yani ye conduction, convection tatha radiation teeno ko ghatane ke liye design kiya jaata hai. Sirf ek hi reet (ek mechanism) rokna iska maksad nahi hai, isliye 'all of these' wala jod sahi hai. Exam point: thermos flask garmi ke teeno rasto (conduction, convection, radiation) ko rokta hai - isliye garam cheez ghanton garam rehti hai.

qe: Which state of matter has the 'Lowest' thermal conductivity?
qh: पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में 'न्यूनतम' तापीय चालकता होती है?
e: Gases ki thermal conductivity sabse kam hoti hai kyunki gas ke anu ek doosre se bahut door hote hain tatha unke beech bandhan durbal hota hai, isliye garmi ek anu se doosre tak pahunchani mushkil hoti hai (udaharan: hawa insulators ki tarah kaam karti hai - double-wall windows, bhusa, tharmocol). Thos padarthon mein anu paas hote hain isliye conductivity zyada hoti hai (dhaatu sabse adhik, kyunki unmein mukta electron bhi hote hain). Isi tarah drav ki conductivity gas se adhik par dhaatu se kam hoti hai. Exam point: sabse kam thermal conductivity wali avastha = gas, kyunki uske anu door-door hote hain - isliye hawa/foam insulation ka kaam karte hain.

qe: What is an 'Adiabatic Wall'?
qh: 'रुद्धोष्म दीवार' (Adiabatic Wall) क्या है?
o: Prevents heat transfer | ऊष्मा स्थानांतरण को रोकती है
e: Adiabatic wall wo seema (boundary) hoti hai jo tantra tatha charon-aur ke beech garmi (heat) ke pravah ko rok deti hai - isliye aisi seema ke asar mein koi heat exchange nahi hota aur process adiabatic ban jaata hai. Iske ulat diathermic wall garmi ko aasaani se jane deti hai (jaise dhaatu ki deewar). Vacuum flask ki deewar, bhusa tatha tharmocol isse ke udaharan hain. Isliye 'garmi ko rokna' hi iski paribhasha hai, na ki garmi ka aasaani se jaana ya tapman ka barabar hona. Exam point: adiabatic wall garmi ke sthanantaran ko rok deti hai, jisse koi heat exchange nahi hota (diathermic wall usi aasan reet se jaane deti hai).

qe: What is the 'Internal Energy' change for a cyclic process?
qh: एक चक्रीय प्रक्रिया के लिए 'आंतरिक ऊर्जा' में परिवर्तन क्या है?
e: Cyclic process mein tantra ghoom-phir kar wapas apni shuruaati avastha mein aa jaata hai; kyunki aantarik urja (U) ek state function hai, shuruaati tatha antim avastha ek hone ke karan usme badlav zero hota hai - Delta U = 0. Isi karan aise process mein net heat tatha net kaam ek doosre ke barabar hote hain (q = -w), aur yahi heat engine ke chakr (cycle) ka aadhaar hai. Net entropy ka badlav bhi shunya hota hai, par taps (temperature) tatha dabav badalte rehte hain. Isliye 'shunya' hi sahi uttar hai; adhik ya kam koi aankda sahih nahi. Exam point: cyclic process mein aantarik urja ka badlav Delta U = 0 hota hai (state function hone ke karan); net heat = net kaam.

qe: Which thermodynamic law defines the concept of 'Internal Energy'?
qh: कौन सा ऊष्मागतिकी नियम 'आंतरिक ऊर्जा' की अवधारणा को परिभाषित करता है?
e: First law of thermodynamics urja sanrakshan ka niyam hai, jo batata hai ki tantra par di gai heat tatha uspar kiye gae kaam se tantra ki aantarik urja (U) badalti hai (Delta U = q + w). Isliye 'internal energy' ki dhaarna isi niyam se banti hai - ye batata hai ki urja na paida hoti hai na nasht, sirf roop badalti hai. Zeroth law tapman ki paribhasha deta hai, second law entropy (va asthirta) tatha third law paramm shunya par entropy batata hai. Exam point: aantarik urja (internal energy) ki dhaarna first law of thermodynamics se banti hai, jo urja sanrakshan (Delta U = q + w) par tika hai.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat Ratio' ($\gamma$) for a rigid Diatomic gas?
qh: एक कठोर द्वि-परमाणुक गैस के लिए 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा अनुपात' ($\gamma$) क्या है?
e: Rigid diatomic gas (jaise H2, N2, O2) mein do atom ek akshar par judte hain, isliye uske swatantrata ki koti (degrees of freedom) 5 hoti hain (3 sthanantaran + 2 ghoornan); isse Cv = 5R/2 aur Cp = 7R/2 nikalta hai, isliye gamma = Cp/Cv = 7/5 = 1.4 hota hai. Isi karan dwiparmaanvik gas ke liye gamma ka aankda 1.4 hi yaad rakha jaata hai (monoatomic ke liye 1.67 aur bahuparmaanvik ke liye 1.33 hota hai). 1.67 ya 1.33 wale aankde isliye yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: rigid diatomic gas ka specific heat ratio gamma = 1.4 (7/5) hota hai, kyunki uske 5 degrees of freedom hote hain.

qe: What is 'Avogadro's Hypothesis' for gases at same T and P?
qh: समान T और P पर गैसों के लिए 'आवोगाद्रो की परिकल्पना' क्या है?
o: Equal molecules for equal volume | समान आयतन में अणुओं की संख्या समान
e: Avogadro ki parikalpana kehti hai ki samaan tapman tatha dabav par sabhi gases ke barabar aayatan mein anuon (molecules) ki sankhya bhi barabar hoti hai - isliye 1 mol gas ka aayatan (STP par 22.4 L) sabhi gases ke liye ek hi hota hai. Isi parikalpana se gas ke aayatan se uske anuon ki ginti nikaali jaati hai, bina ye jaane ki kaun si gas hai. Isiliye 'barabar dravyaman' ya 'barabar ghanatva' wale kathan yahan sahi nahi hain, kyunki gas ke bhaar alag-alag ho sakte hain. Exam point: Avogadro ki parikalpana - samaan T aur P par barabar aayatan wali gases mein anuon ki sankhya barabar hoti hai (isliye 22.4 L sabhi gases ke liye ek mol).

qe: What is the unit of 'Stefan-Boltzmann' constant ($\sigma$)?
qh: 'स्टीफन-बोल्ट्जमैन' नियतांक का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Chhodi gayi urja ki ganit mein jo bhi gunaank tapman ki chauthi ghat ke saath aata hai, wahi Stefan-Boltzmann constant hai; kyunki usme K ki ghat 4 hai, isliye uski ikai W/m2.K4 ban jaati hai. Iski sankhya lagbhag 5.67 x 10^-8 W/m2.K4 hoti hai. Isi karan E = sigma x T^4 likhne par maan sahi aata hai; iska matrak W/m.K ya J/kg.K nahi ho sakta (wo thermal conductivity tatha specific heat ke hain). Dhyan rakhein: sigma ka matrak samajhna prashn mein aksar poochha jaata hai. Exam point: Stefan-Boltzmann constant ka matrak W/m2.K4 hota hai (sankhya lagbhag 5.67 x 10^-8), kyunki ye urja per area per T^4 batata hai.

qe: Which material is used in 'Bolometers'?
qh: 'बोलोमीटर' में किस सामग्री का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bolometer ek atyant sanvedansheel (sensitive) yantra hai jo vaikiran (radiation) ki urja maap kar tapman ka antar bataata hai; iske andar aisi patli parat lagai jaati hai jiski vidyut-pratirodhakta (resistance) tapman ke saath badalti hai - aur yahi gun semiconductor (jaise thermistor) wale padarthon mein bahut tez hota hai, isliye bolometer mein semiconductor istemal hota hai. Iske ulat tamba-nickel jaisi dhaatuen kam sanvedansheel hoti hain aur ceramic ya plastic radiation ko maapne mein itne upyukt nahi hote. Isliye bolometer mein semiconductor ka sahi jod hai. Exam point: bolometer mein semiconductor (thermistor) wali parat istemal hoti hai, kyunki unka resistance tapman ke saath tezi se badalta hai.

qe: What is 'Joule-Thomson' effect used for primarily?
qh: 'जूल-थॉमसन' प्रभाव का मुख्य रूप से उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
o: Cooling gases | गैसों को ठंडा करने के लिए
e: Joule-Thomson effect kehta hai ki jab gas ko ek chhidra (pinhole) ya valve se guzara jaata hai to wo fail kar tapman badal leti hai - kuchh gases is prakshep mein thandi ho jaati hain (jaise hydrogen-nitrogen neeche khaas tapman par), isliye iska sabse bada upyog gas ko thanda karna (liquefaction) hai. Isi siddhant par Linde ki vidhi dwara hawa se nitrogen tatha oxygen alag ki jaati hai. Isliye 'cooling gases' hi iska mukhya upyog hai. Dak-ticket, bijli paida karna ya tapman maapna iska seedha maksad nahi hain. Exam point: Joule-Thomson effect ka upyog mukhya roop se gases ko thanda karne (liquefaction) ke liye hota hai, kyunki chhidra se guzarne par gas ka tapman badal jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Efficiency' of a heat engine in terms of $W$ and $Q_1$?
qh: $W$ और $Q_1$ के संदर्भ में ऊष्मा इंजन की 'दक्षता' क्या है?
e: Heat engine ki efficiency batati hai ki di gai heat ka kitna hissa kaam mein badla - agar engine ko Q1 heat mili tatha usne W kaam kiya, to efficiency = W/Q1 hoti hai (tatha Q1 - Q2 = W hone ke karan ye (Q1 - Q2)/Q1 bhi likha jaata hai). Isliye efficiency ka sahi roop W/Q1 hai; ye hamesha 1 se kam hota hai kyunki Q2 heat sink ko dena zaroori hai. Q1/W, W x Q1 ya Q2/W jaise roop ganit ke hisab se sahi nahi (Q2/W refrigerator ka COP hota hai, efficiency nahi). Exam point: heat engine ki efficiency = W/Q1 hoti hai (kiye gae kaam tatha di gai heat ka anupat); ye hamesha 1 se kam hoti hai.

qe: Which state of matter is 'Plasma' associated with?
qh: 'प्लाज्मा' पदार्थ की किस अवस्था से जुड़ा है?
e: Plasma ko padarth ki chauthi avastha (fourth state) kaha jaata hai - ismein gas ke zyada garam hone par electron atom se alag ho jaate hain, isliye dhanaveshi ion tatha rinaveshi electron ka mishran banta hai. Suraj tatha taare, bijli ki chamak (lightning), aur neon sign tube mein yahi avastha hoti hai. Thos, drav tatha gas ke baad ye chauthi avastha maani jaati hai, jabki Bose-Einstein condensate ko kabhi paanchvin avastha kaha jaata hai. Isliye 'chauthi' hi is prashn ka sahi jod hai, kyunki plasma ki bahut khaas pehchaan uski aavyoshit urja hai. Exam point: plasma padarth ki chauthi avastha hai - ismein garam gas ke atom toot kar ion tatha electron ban jaate hain (Suraj, lightning, neon tube).

qe: What is 'Critical Pressure' of Water?
qh: पानी का 'क्रांतिक दाब' क्या है?
e: Paani ka critical pressure lagbhag 218 atmosphere hota hai - is dabav tatha critical temperature (374 degree C) se upar paani ki drav tatha gas avastha alag-alag nahi rehti, ek hi 'supercritical fluid' bana rehta hai. Isi karan paani ko is dabav se kam par hi bhaap banaya ja sakta hai, aur bhaap turbine mein 100-250 atm tak kaam hota hai. 1 atm (saadharan dabav) ya 100 atm jaise aankde critical pressure nahi hain, kyunki 1 atm to samundar-tal ka dabav hai. Exam point: paani ka critical pressure lagbhag 218 atm hota hai (critical temperature 374 degree C ke saath); isse upar drav-gas ka bhed khatm ho jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Heat Capacity' of 1 gram of water?
qh: 1 ग्राम पानी की 'ऊष्मीय क्षमता' क्या है?
e: 1 gram paani ki heat capacity 1 calorie per degree C hoti hai (yani ushe 1 degree garam karne ke liye 1 calorie chahiye). Yahi paribhasha hi calorie ki hai, isliye paani ki specific heat sabse sugam (convenient) maani jaati hai aur usi se anya padarthon ki tulna hoti hai (jaise dhaatuon ki specific heat 0.1 se 0.2 cal/g degree C hoti hai). Isliye 4.18, 80 ya 540 (latent heat ke aankde) is specific heat ke nahi hain. Exam point: 1 gram paani ki heat capacity = 1 cal/degree C hoti hai; yahi calorie ki paribhasha ka aadhaar hai.

qe: What is 'Absolute Zero' on the Fahrenheit scale?
qh: फारेनहाइट पैमाने पर 'परम शून्य' क्या है?
e: Paramm shunya (absolute zero) wo nyoonatam tapman hai jahan anuon ki gati lagbhag ruk jaati hai; Celsius scale par ye -273.15 degree C hai, aur Fahrenheit scale par -459.67 degree F hota hai. Yahi karan hai ki Kelvin scale (jisme 0 K = -273.15 C) scientific kaam ke liye istemal hoti hai. 0 F, -273 F ya -100 F jaise aankde paramma shunya ke nahi hain (0 F to namak-baraf ke mishran ka tapman hai). Exam point: absolute zero Fahrenheit scale par -459.67 degree F hota hai (Celsius mein -273.15 C tatha Kelvin mein 0 K); is tapman par anuon ki gati lagbhag ruk jaati hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Freezing Point' of water under 'High Pressure'?
qh: 'उच्च दाब' पर पानी के 'हिमांक' का क्या होता है?
e: Adhik dabav (high pressure) barf ke galaank ko ghatata hai - isliye barf pighalne ka tapman 0 degree C se neeche chala jaata hai. Iska kaaran ye hai ki barf ka aayatan paani se adhik hota hai, isliye dabav badhane par Le-Chatelier ke anusar wahi disha badhti hai jismein aayatan ghatta hai - yani barf pighalna. Isi karan patin (skating) khelne wale pattay ke neeche ka dabav barf ko pighla kar chikni parat banata hai, aur glaciers ke neeche bhi ye asar dikhta hai. 'Badhta hai' ya 'same rehta hai' wale kathan paani ke liye galat hain (baaki padarthon jaise wax mein ulta hota hai). Exam point: adhik dabav par paani ka freezing point ghatta hai - isliye barf dabav mein pighal jaati hai (skating isi kaaran aasaan hoti hai).

qe: Which cycle is more efficient, Otto or Diesel, for the same compression ratio?
qh: समान संपीड़न अनुपात के लिए कौन सा चक्र अधिक कुशल है, ऑटो या डीजल?
e: Samaanya compression ratio par Otto (petrol) cycle ki efficiency Diesel cycle se adhik hoti hai, kyunki Otto cycle mein heat constant volume par milti hai (isliye tapman tatha dabav dono badh kar urja ka upyog behtar hota hai), jabki Diesel cycle mein heat constant pressure par milti hai (jismein aayatan badhne se thodi urja kharch hoti hai). Dhyan rakhein: vyavhar mein diesel engine ka compression ratio bahut adhik (14-22) hota hai, isliye wo petrol se adhik efficient dikhta hai - par tulna saman ratio par karte hain to Otto aage nikalta hai. Carnot aur Rankine cycles alag vishay hain. Exam point: samaan compression ratio par Otto cycle ki efficiency Diesel se adhik hoti hai, jabki vyavhar mein diesel adhik compression ratio ke karan behtar efficient hota hai.

qe: What is 'Coefficient of Performance' (COP) for a refrigerator?
qh: एक रेफ्रिजरेटर के लिए 'निष्पादन गुणांक' (COP) क्या है?
e: Refrigerator ka coefficient of performance (COP) batata hai ki thande bhandar (cold reservoir) se nikali gai heat Q2 tatha us me lagne wale kaam W ka anupat kitna hai, isliye COP = Q2/W hota hai. Achhe refrigerator mein ye maan 1 se kaafi adhik ho sakta hai (jaise 4 ya 5), kyunki kaam ke badle bahut adhik heat transfer hoti hai. Iska ulta roop W/Q2, Q1/W ya Q2 x W nahi hota; Q1/W hota to wo heat pump ke COP ke roop mein aata hai. Exam point: refrigerator ka COP = Q2/W hota hai (thande bhandar se nikali gai heat tatha lagaye gae kaam ka anupat), jo 1 se adhik bhi ho sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Black Body' absorptivity ($\alpha$)?
qh: 'कृष्ण पिंड' की अवशोषकता ($\alpha$) क्या है?
e: Black body (kala padarth) wo aadarsh padarth hota hai jo apne upar padne wali poori urja ko sokh leta hai - isliye uski absorptivity (alpha) 1 maani jaati hai aur reflectivity 0 hoti hai; usi tarah uski emissivity bhi 1 hoti hai. Isi karan kala padarth apne tapman ke hisaab se sabse adhik urja chhodta hai, aur iski radiation ka vitaran (distribution) Planck ke niyam se nikalta hai. Kisi bhi vyavharik satah ke liye alpha 0 se 1 ke beech hota hai (grey body ke liye bhi), isliye 0, 100 ya infinite jaise aankde black body ke nahi hain. Exam point: black body ki absorptivity alpha = 1 hoti hai (poori urja sokh leta hai) - isi karan uski emissivity bhi 1 hoti hai.

qe: What is the relation between 'C' and 'K'?
qh: 'C' और 'K' के बीच क्या संबंध है?
e: Celsius tatha Kelvin scale ka sambandh K = C + 273 (theek se C + 273.15) hai - yani Celsius ke aankde mein 273 jodne par paramm (absolute) tapman kelvin mein mil jaata hai. Ye sambandh isliye zaroori hai ki sabhi gas tatha thermodynamics ke sutra kelvin mein hi sahi baithte hain; Celsius mein negative aankde (jaise -20 C) se ganit galat ho jaata hai. Isliye K = C + 273 hi sahi roop hai. C + 273/5 ya K = C - 273 jaise roop galat hain (C/5 ka sambandh Fahrenheit ke badlav mein aata hai). Exam point: Celsius se Kelvin jaane ka sambandh K = C + 273 hota hai; isliye 0 degree C = 273 K tatha 27 degree C = 300 K hota hai.

qe: Which material is used in 'Heat Shields' of spacecraft?
qh: अंतरिक्ष यान के 'हीट शील्ड' में किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Spacecraft ke heat shield (ushma dhaal) mein ablative ceramic (lupatatmak siramik) istemal hota hai - jab vaayumandal mein tez raftar se aane wale yantra ki satah bahut garam ho jaati hai, to ye ceramic parat pighal-tatha-vasheebhoot (melt aur vapour) hokar urja apne saath le jaati hai. Isse yantra ke andar ka hissa thanda rehta hai (Apollo tatha mangal yaanon mein yahi tarika istemal hua). Saadharan dhaatu ya plastic itni garmi sah nahi paate, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: spacecraft ke heat shield mein ablative ceramics istemal hote hain, jo pighal-vashpeekaran hokar urja apne saath le jaate hain aur yantra ko bachaate hain.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Efficiency' of a heat engine dependent on?
qh: एक ऊष्मा इंजन की 'अधिकतम दक्षता' किस पर निर्भर करती है?
o: Temperature of source and sink | स्रोत और सिंक के तापमान पर
e: Kisi bhi heat engine ki adhiktam (maximum) efficiency sirf uske source (garam bhandar) tatha sink (thande bhandar) ke paramm tapman par nirbhar karti hai - Carnot ke anusar eta = 1 - T2/T1, jahan T kelvin mein hai. Isliye engine ke fuel, aakaar ya kaam karne wale padarth se ye seema nahi badalti. Isi karan 100% efficiency ke liye sink ka tapman 0 K hona zaroori hai, jo sambhav nahi - isliye prakritik engine ki efficiency hamesha 1 se kam hoti hai. Exam point: heat engine ki maximum efficiency source tatha sink ke tapman par nirbhar karti hai (eta = 1 - T2/T1); fuel ya engine ke design se ye seema nahi badalti.

qe: What is 'Latent Heat' of sublimation?
qh: 'ऊर्ध्वपातन' की गुप्त ऊष्मा क्या है?
o: Sum of latent heat of fusion and vaporization | गलन और वाष्पीकरण की गुप्त ऊष्मा का योग
e: Sublimation ki latent heat wo urja hai jo 1 kg thos padarth ko seedha bhaap (gas) banane ke liye chahiye hoti hai; kyunki thos padarth pehle pighal kar drav banta hai aur phir bhaap, isliye kul urja fusion tatha vaporization ki latent heat ke jod ke barabar hi hoti hai - L(sub) = L(fus) + L(vap). Isliye ice ke liye 80 + 540 = 620 cal/g hoti hai. Iska gar (product) ya antar lena ganit ke hisaab se galat hai, kyunki enthalpy state function hone ke karan path se nahi badalti. Exam point: sublimation ki latent heat = fusion ki latent heat + vaporization ki latent heat (dono ka jod); jaise barf ke liye 80 + 540 = 620 cal/g.

qe: Which law of thermodynamics states that 'Specific heat of solids reaches zero at 0 K'?
qh: ऊष्मागतिकी का कौन सा नियम कहता है कि '0 K पर ठोसों की विशिष्ट ऊष्मा शून्य हो जाती है'?
e: Third law of thermodynamics kehta hai ki jab tapman paramm shunya (0 K) ke bahut nazdeek pahunchta hai to shudha sphaiktik (crystalline) padarth ki entropy tatha uski specific heat dono shunya ki or badh jaati hain - yahi kathan is prashn ka sahi jod hai. Ye niyam bataata hai ki 0 K par entropy ko zero maan kar hisaab kiya ja sakta hai (absolute entropy). Zeroth law tapman ki paribhasha deta hai, first law urja sanrakshan tatha second law entropy ki disha batata hai, isliye wo is khaas kathan ke nahi hain. Exam point: yahi third law of thermodynamics hai - 0 K par shuddh crystalline padarth ki entropy (tatha uski specific heat) shunya ho jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Psychrometer' used to measure?
qh: 'साइक्रोमीटर' (Psychrometer) का उपयोग क्या मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Psychrometer (ya hygrometer) ek yantra hai jismein do thermometer lagte hain - ek sookha (dry bulb) tatha doosra geele kapde mein lipta (wet bulb); geele bulb se paani ke vashpeekaran se tapman thoda ghat jaata hai aur dono thermometer ke aankdon ke antar se hawa ki aadrata (humidity) nikaali jaati hai. Isliye ye sapeksh aadrata (relative humidity) maapne ka saadharan yantra hai, jo mausam-vigyaan tatha eendhan (fuel) adhyayan mein kaam aata hai. Tapman, vayu-dabav ya vrishti ka maap alag yantron se hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: psychrometer (hygrometer) sapeksh aadrata (relative humidity) maapta hai - do thermometer ke aankdon ke antar se ye nikalta hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Internal Energy' of a gas during free expansion?
qh: मुक्त प्रसार (Free expansion) के दौरान गैस की 'आंतरिक ऊर्जा' का क्या होता है?
e: Gas ke mukta prasaar (free expansion) mein gas khaali jagah mein fail jaati hai bina kisi dabav ke virodh kaam kiye (w = 0) aur bina heat liye (q = 0 bhi, kyunki ise maloom bina kiya jaata hai) - isliye first law ke anusar Delta U = q + w = 0 hota hai, isliye aantarik urja wahi (sthir) rehti hai. Isi karan aadarsh gas ke free expansion mein tapman bhi nahi badalta (Joule ka prayog). Isliye ye kathan sahi hai ki aantarik urja sthir rehti hai, jabki aayatan badh jaata hai tatha gas thandi nahi hoti. Exam point: gas ke free expansion mein koi kaam ya heat exchange nahi hota, isliye aantarik urja (Delta U = 0) sthir rehti hai.

qe: What is 'Emissivity' ($\epsilon$) for a grey body?
qh: एक ग्रे बॉडी (Grey body) के लिए 'उत्सर्जकता' ($\epsilon$) क्या होती है?
e: Grey body (bhoora padarth) wo vastavik padarth hota hai jiska absorptivity sabhi tarangdairdhya (wavelength) ke liye ek hi maan rakhta hai (par 1 se kam), isliye uski emissivity bhi 0 se 1 ke beech hi hoti hai - yani ye black body jitni urja nahi chhodta par bilkul shunya bhi nahi. Isi karan vyavharik padarthon ke radiation ka hisaab lagane mein ye epsi ke gunaank ka istemal hota hai (E = e x sigma x T^4). Shuniyata wale wikalp (0 ya 1 se bahar) galat hain, kyunki shudh black body ki emissivity 1 hoti hai. Exam point: grey body ki emissivity 0 se 1 ke beech hoti hai - ye poori tarah kala padarth nahi hota, isliye ye black body se kam urja chhodta hai.

qe: What is the principle of 'Air Conditioning'?
qh: 'एयर कंडीशनिंग' का सिद्धांत क्या है?
o: Evaporation and compression | वाष्पीकरण और संपीड़न
e: Air conditioner ka siddhant vashpeekaran (evaporation) tatha sampaedan (compression) ke chakra (vapour-compression cycle) par tika hai - ismein coolant (refrigerant) kam dabav par kamre ki garmi sokh kar bhaap banta hai, phir compressor se dabav-barhakar bahar (condenser) mein garmi chhod kar drav ban jaata hai - is chakra ke dauraan kamre ki garmi bahar nikal jaati hai. Isi karan AC kamre ko thanda karta hai tatha bahar garam hawa chhodta hai. Iska sambandh keval rang ya ghantva se nahi hai. Exam point: air conditioning ka siddhant coolant ke vashpeekaran tatha sampaedan ke chakra par tika hai, jisse kamre ki garmi bahar nikal jaati hai.

qe: Which gas is used for 'Cryogenic' cooling of superconductors?
qh: सुपरकंडक्टर्स की 'क्रायोजेनिक' कूलिंग के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग होता है?
e: Superconductors ko uske critical temperature (aam taur par -196 degree C se bahut neeche) tak laane ke liye cryogenic cooling ki zaroorat hoti hai, aur uske liye liquid helium (kvathank 4.2 K) istemal kiya jaata hai - kyunki yahi drav itna thanda ho sakta hai jahan niyamit vidyut-parirodhak shunya ho jaata hai (MRI machine ke magnet isi tarah thande kiye jaate hain). Liquid nitrogen (77 K) bhi thanda karta hai par taamba-oxide jaise high-temperature superconductors ke liye hi upyukt hai. Isliye aam superconductors ke liye liquid helium hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: superconductors ki cryogenic cooling ke liye liquid helium (4.2 K) istemal hoti hai - isse param-nimn tapman par resistance shunya ho jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Thermal Equilibrium'?
qh: 'तापीय संतुलन' क्या है?
e: Thermal equilibrium (taap-santulan) wo avastha hai jab do vastuein jo garmi ka aadan-pradan kar sakti hain, ek hi tapman par aa jaati hain - uske baad garmi ka net bahav ruk jaata hai (chaahe dono ke andar garmi bani reh sakti hai). Inhi ke aadhaar par zeroth law of thermodynamics bana hai (jisse thermometer kaam karta hai) tatha tapman ki dhaarna banti hai. Isliye 'same temperature' hi sahi jod hai; aayatan ya dabav ka barabar hona is avastha ke liye aavashyak nahi hai. Exam point: thermal equilibrium ka matlab do (ya adhik) vastuein ek hi tapman par aa jaana - uske baad garmi ka net pravah shunya ho jaata hai.

qe: What is the value of 'Solar Constant' (S) approximately?
qh: 'सौर नियतांक' (S) का मान लगभग कितना है?
e: Solar constant (S) ko solar constant kehte hain kyunki ye dharti ke vaayumandal ke bahari hisse par ek second mein per square metre aane wali suraj ki urja batata hai, jo lagbhag 1.36 kW/m2 (yani 1360 W/m2) hoti hai. Isi aankde se solar panel ki kshamta tatha dharti ka urja-santulan nikala jaata hai. Isi tarah suraj ka kul urja 3.8 x 10^26 W maana jaata hai. Isse kam ya adhik maan (jaise 100 W/m2) solar constant nahi hain, kyunki yahi vaayumandal ke bahari sire par maapi gai ek sthir sankhya hai. Exam point: solar constant ka maan lagbhag 1.36 kW/m2 hota hai - ye dharti ke vaayumandal ke bahari hisse par per second per square metre milne wali surya-urja hai.

qe: Which state of matter has 'Highest' specific heat?
qh: पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में 'उच्चतम' विशिष्ट ऊष्मा होती है?
e: Padarth ki avastha ke hisaab se specific heat sabse adhik drav paani mein hoti hai (1 cal/g degree C); isliye paani itni aasaani se garam ya thanda nahi hota aur samudr vaayumandal ke tapman ko santulit rakhte hain, tatha shareer ka sara jeev-ras (body fluids) isi gun ka fayda uthaata hai. Dhaatuon ki specific heat bahut kam hoti hai (isliye lohe ka taava jaldi garam ho jaata hai) aur gases ki bhi kam hoti hai (tatha thos mein bhi alag-alag). Isliye 'thos' ya 'gas' ka specific heat sabse adhik nahi hota. Exam point: sabse adhik specific heat drav (paani) mein hoti hai (1 cal/g degree C) - isliye paani heat ko zyada der tak rok kar rakhta hai.

qe: What is 'Steady State' in heat conduction?
qh: ऊष्मा चालन में 'स्थिर अवस्था' (Steady State) क्या है?
o: Temp does not change with time | तापमान समय के साथ नहीं बदलता
e: Steady state (sthir awastha) mein garmi ke bahav (conduction) ke dauraan har bindu ka tapman samay ke saath nahi badalta - yani ek hi jagah ka tapman sthir rehta hai, chaahe ek sire se doosre sire tak tapman ka antar tatha pravah lagataar chalta rahe. Isi karan is awastha mein garmi ka pravah ki gati sthir hoti hai, jise Fourier ke niyam se nikaala jaata hai. 'Tapman sthir hona' hi iski paribhasha hai, na ki tapman ka barabar hona ya tapman ka samay ke saath badhna. Exam point: steady state mein har bindu ka tapman samay ke saath sthir rehta hai (badalta nahi), halanki garmi ka pravah chalta rehta hai.

qe: What is the 'Triple Point' of Water in Kelvin?
qh: केल्विन में पानी का 'त्रिक बिंदु' क्या है?
e: Triple point (tribindu) ek aisa nishchit bindu hai jahan thos, drav tatha vapasheel avastha teeno ek saath santulan mein rehti hain; paani ke liye ye 273.16 K (0.01 degree C) aur 611.2 Pa dabav par milta hai. Isi karan Kelvin scale ko paani ke triple point ko 273.16 K maan kar paribhashit kiya gaya tha, isliye ye aankda science mein bahut mahatvapooran hai. 273.15, 373 ya 100 jaise aankde is aankde se alag hain (373 K paani ka kvathank hai). Exam point: paani ka triple point 273.16 K (0.01 degree C) hota hai - yahi Kelvin scale ki paribhasha ka aadhaar maana jaata hai.

qe: In an 'Isobaric' process, work done is equal to:
qh: 'समदाबी' प्रक्रिया में किया गया कार्य किसके बराबर होता है?
e: Isobaric process mein dabav (P) sthir rehta hai, isliye kaam ka sutra w = P x Delta V (dabav x aayatan mein badlav) ban jaata hai - kyunki sthir dabav par hi P ko bahar nikaal kar aayatan ke badlav se guna kiya ja sakta hai. Isi karan bina piston ke khule bartan mein hoti kriya ka kaam P.Delta V se nikalta hai, aur aise kaam ko 'pressure-volume work' kehte hain. Isothermal process mein kaam nRT ln(V2/V1) hota hai aur isochoric mein shunya - isliye wo aankde is paribhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: isobaric process mein kaam = P x Delta V hota hai (sthir dabav par dabav ko badlav ke saath guna kiya jaata hai).

qe: What is 'Kinetic Theory of Gases' based on?
qh: 'गैसों का अणुगति सिद्धांत' किस पर आधारित है?
e: Kinetic theory of gases ye maan kar chalti hai ki gas bahut se chhote kanon (molecules) se bani hai jo lagataar tedhe-medhe (random) gati karte hain, aapas mein takraate hain aur deewar se takra kar dabav daalte hain. Isi aadhaar par dabav, tapman tatha gati ki vyakhya hoti hai - gas ka tapman anuon ki ausat gati-urja ka maap hota hai tatha dabav unke takraav ka parinaam hota hai. Isliye is theory ka mool aadhaar 'aanvik gati' (molecular motion) hai, na ki rasayanik bandhan ya bijli. Isi par avogadro ki parikalpana tatha gas ke niyam bhi nirbhar karte hain. Exam point: kinetic theory of gases aanvik gati (molecular motion) par tika hai - isme gas ke kan random gati karte hain aur deewar se takraav se dabav banta hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Boiling Point' of water in a vacuum?
qh: निर्वात में पानी के 'क्वथनांक' का क्या होता है?
e: Vacuum (khaali) mein dabav bahut kam hone ke karan paani ka kvathank (boiling point) ghat jaata hai - kyunki bhaap banne ke liye bahari dabav ko todna nahi padta, isliye paani 100 degree C se kam par hi ubhalne lagta hai. Bahut kam dabav par paani room temperature par bhi ubhal sakta hai (isliye uchch sthalon par bhaati jaldi banti hai aur vacuum distillation sambhav hota hai). Iske ulat adhik dabav (pressure cooker) mein kvathank badh jaata hai. Kyunki dabav badhne par kvathank bhi badh jaata hai, isliye baaki dono sambhav yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: vacuum mein paani ka boiling point ghat jaata hai (dabav kam hone se) - isliye uchch pahadi kshetron mein khana dheere pakta hai.

qe: Which material is used in 'Pyrometers' for non-contact measurement?
qh: गैर-संपर्क माप के लिए 'पाइरोमीटर' में किसका उपयोग होता है?
e: Pyrometer (non-contact thermometer) bina padarth ko chhue tapman maapta hai; ye padarth se nikalne wali infraraid (ushma) kirnon ko sensor se maap leta hai, isliye bhatti, pighli dhaatu tatha jwalaamukhi ke lava ka tapman bhi yahi se maapa jaata hai. Kyunki ise chhune ki zaroorat nahi hoti, jaise bhaati ke andar ya chalti machine ka tapman - wahi iska sabse bada fayda hai. Mercury thermometer ya thermocouple (jo chhukar maapte hain) aise uchch tapman par jal jaate ya pighal jaate, isliye wo vikalp yahan upyukt nahi. Exam point: pyrometer infraraid (avrakt) sensors dwara bina chhue tapman maapta hai - isliye ise bhatti/uchch tapman ke liye istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Specific Latent Heat' unit?
qh: 'विशिष्ट गुप्त ऊष्मा' का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Vishesh gupat ushma (specific latent heat) uska amash hai ki 1 kilogram padarth ki avastha badalne ke liye kitni urja chahiye, isliye iski ikai joule per kilogram (J/kg) hoti hai. Isi karan paani ki bhaap banane ki latent heat 2.26 x 10^6 J/kg likhi jaati hai, jabki kisi dhaatu ki ye value kam hoti hai. J/kg.K (specific heat) ya J (urja) iski ikai nahi hain, kyunki latent heat mein prati kilogram bhaar diya jaata hai par tapman ka antar nahi aata (tapman sthir rehta hai). Exam point: specific latent heat ki SI ikai J/kg hoti hai; ismein 1 kg padarth ki avastha badalne ki urja batayi jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Adiabatic Compression' result in a gas?
qh: गैस में 'रुद्धोष्म संपीड़न' का क्या परिणाम होता है?
e: Adiabatic compression (bina garmi nikale dabana) mein gas par kaam kiya jaata hai, aur kyunki heat bahar nahi ja paati, wo saara kaam aantarik urja mein badal jaata hai - isliye gas ka tapman badh jaata hai; yahi karan cycle pump ki nali garam ho jaati hai. Isi siddhant ka upyog diesel engine mein hota hai, jahan hawa ko 15-20 guna dabakar 500-700 degree C tak garam kar diya jaata hai taaki diesel ke chhidkav par wo bhadak uthe. Adiabatic expansion mein ulta asar hota hai (gas thandi hoti hai). Exam point: adiabatic compression se gas garam ho jaati hai, kyunki kiye gaye kaam ki urja tapman badha deti hai.

qe: What is 'Bimetallic Strip' used for?
qh: 'द्वि-धात्विक पट्टी' (Bimetallic Strip) का उपयोग किसमें होता है?
e: Bimetallic strip do alag dhaatuon (jaise pital tatha loha, ya invar tatha pital) ki judi patti hoti hai; tapman badhne par ek dhaatu adhik failti hai isliye patti mud (bend) jaati hai - isi mudav se vidyut paripath chalu ya band hota hai, isliye yahi thermostat (refrigerator, iron, oven ka tapman-niyantrak) ka mukhya ang hai. Iske ulat thermometer mein tapman ko bhaap-paani-column se maapa jaata hai - isliye 'thermostat' hi iska khaas upyog hai (bilkul tapman ko maapna nahi, use niyantrit karna). Isi tarah fire alarm mein bhi bimetallic strip ka upyog hota hai. Exam point: bimetallic strip ka sabse aam upyog thermostat hai - tapman badhne par uski mudav se circuit khulta-badata hai.

qe: Which law states that 'Total pressure of a gas mixture is sum of partial pressures'?
qh: कौन सा नियम कहता है कि 'गैस मिश्रण का कुल दाब आंशिक दाबों का योग होता है'?
e: Dalton's law of partial pressures kehta hai ki paraspar kriya na karne wali gases ke mishran ka kul dabav un sabhi gases ke aalag-aalag (partial) dabavon ke jod ke barabar hota hai; isliye P(total) = P1 + P2 + P3 ... hota hai aur har gas ka hissa mole fraction se nikaala jaata hai (Pi = xi x Ptotal). Isi niyam se shvaas mein oxygen tatha nitrogen ke hisse tatha paani mein ghuli gasen samajh aati hain. Boyle, Charles ya Gay-Lussac ke niyam ek hi gas ke aayatan-tapman-dabav ke sambandh batate hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: gas-mishran ka total pressure partial pressures ka jod hota hai = Dalton's law of partial pressures.

qe: What is 'Critical Temperature' of Oxygen approximately?
qh: ऑक्सीजन का 'क्रांतिक तापमान' लगभग कितना है?
e: Oxygen ki critical temperature lagbhag -118 degree C (-118 C) hoti hai - is tapman se upar oxygen ko dabav se bhi drav nahi kiya ja sakta; isliye oxygen ko drav (liquid) banane ke liye ushe pehle -118 C se neeche thanda karna padta hai. Is aankde ki tulna karein to nitrogen ki -146 C, hydrogen ki -240 C tatha helium ki -268 C hoti hai - isliye halki gas utni hi kam tapman par drav hoti hai. 31 degree C (CO2), 374 degree C (paani) jaise aankde anya padarthon ke hain, isliye wo oxygen ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: oxygen ki critical temperature lagbhag -118 degree C hoti hai; isse upar dabav badhane par bhi oxygen drav nahi hoti.

qe: What is 'Work Done' in an 'Isothermal' expansion of n moles?
qh: n मोल के 'समतापी' प्रसार में 'किया गया कार्य' क्या है?
e: Isothermal expansion mein tapman sthir rehta hai, isliye aadarsh gas ki aantarik urja nahi badalti aur poori di gai heat kaam mein badal jaati hai; is sthir tapman par dabav-aayatan ke sambandh ko samghatit (integrate) karne par nRT ln(V2/V1) nikalta hai - yani kaam aayatan ke anupat (log) ke hisaab se badhta hai. Isliye nRT ln(V2/V1) hi is prashn ka sahi jod hai (yahan ln natural log hai). Isobaric ke liye P.Delta V, adiabatic ke liye (P1V1 - P2V2)/(gamma-1) aur isochoric ke liye shunya hota hai. Exam point: isothermal expansion of n moles mein kaam = nRT ln(V2/V1) hota hai, kyunki tapman sthir hone se poori heat kaam mein badalti hai.

qe: What is 'Thermal Convection' primarily driven by?
qh: 'तापीय संवहन' मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा संचालित होता है?
e: Thermal convection (ushma-samvahan) mukhya roop se ghanatva ke antar (density differences) se chalta hai - garam padarth halka hokar upar uthta hai aur thanda bhari padarth neeche baithta hai, isse ek chakra (current) banta hai jo garmi le jaata hai. Isi karan kamre mein heater upar lagane se garmi neeche tak jaldi pahunchti hai (aur AC upar lagta hai), aur samudr tatha vaayumandal mein bhi ye chakra bante hain. Conductivity, radiation ya pressure ka asar alag- alag prakiyaon mein hota hai, isliye wo vikalp convection ka mukhya kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: thermal convection ghanatva ke antar ke karan hota hai - garam halka padarth upar tatha thanda bhari padarth neeche jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Regelation' primarily observed in?
qh: 'पुनर्हिमायन' मुख्य रूप से किसमें देखा जाता है?
e: Regelation ka matlab hai ki dabav badhne par barf pighalti hai tatha dabav hatte hi wo phir jam jaati hai - yahi asar mukhya roop se barf (ice) mein dekha jaata hai, kyunki paani ka ghanatva barf se adhik hone ke karan dabav se barf ka galaank ghatta hai. Isi karan taar (wire) ke bhaar se barf ka tukhda kat jaata hai par katne ke baad wo phir se jama jaata hai, tatha skating ke pattay barf par chikni parat banate hain. Wax ya kaanch mein ulta asar hota hai (unka galaank dabav se badhta hai) tatha gas mein ye kathan lagu nahi hota. Exam point: regelation barf mein dekhi jaati hai - dabav se barf pighalti hai aur dabav hatne par phir se jam jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Entropy' of a 'Perfect Crystal' at 0 K?
qh: 0 K पर एक 'आदर्श क्रिस्टल' की 'एन्ट्रॉपी' क्या होती है?
e: Third law ke anusar shuddh tatha pooree tarah spaatik (perfectly crystalline) padarth ki entropy paramm shunya (0 K) par shunya hoti hai, kyunki us tapman par anuon ka vaigyanik vikalp ek hi reh jaata hai (S = k ln W, aur W = 1 hone se S = 0). Isi karan 0 K par uski specific heat bhi lagbhag shunya ho jaati hai. Yadi kristal mein vikriti (defect) ho, to thodi residual entropy bach sakti hai - isliye ye kathan aadarsh kristal ke liye hai. 1, 100 ya infinite jaise aankdon ka koi aadhaar nahi hai. Exam point: 0 K par shuddh perfect crystalline padarth ki entropy zero maani jaati hai - yahi third law of thermodynamics ka mool kathan hai.

qe: Which property of water is used in 'Hot water bags'?
qh: 'गर्म पानी की थैलियों' में पानी के किस गुण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: High Specific Heat | उच्च विशिष्ट ऊष्मा
e: Garam paani ki bottle (hot water bag) mein yahi gun kaam aata hai ki paani ki vishesh ushma (specific heat) bahut adhik hoti hai (1 cal/g degree C), isliye wo ek baar bhar kar rakhi jaaye to bahut der tak garmi chhodti rehti hai aur apna tapman dheere-dheere girta hai. Isliye shareer ko lambe samay tak halki garmi dene ke liye paani sabse upyukt drav hai. Loha ya tamba bhar dete to wo tezi se thanda ho jaata, aur uski conductivity adhik hone se haath jan jal jaate - isliye specific heat hi sahi gun hai. Exam point: hot water bag mein paani ka uchch specific heat hona kaam aata hai, kyunki wo garmi ko der tak rok kar dheere-dheere deta hai.

qe: What is 'Absolute Humidity' independent of?
qh: 'निरपेक्ष आर्द्रता' किससे स्वतंत्र होती है?
e: Absolute humidity batati hai ki hawa ke ek unit aayatan mein kitne gram jal-vashp hain; ye sirf paani ki matara (mass) se tay hoti hai, isliye ye taapman ya dabav jaise kisi ek gun se svatantra (independent) nahi hoti - tapman tatha dabav dono badalne par usi aayatan mein jal-vashp ki matara bhi badalti hai. Vyavhar mein ye ghat-ti-badhti hai (jaise tapman badhne par hawa zyada vashp rok sakti hai, isliye maan badalta hai). Isi karan is prashn mein 'none of these' wala jod sahi hai - yani ye tapman, dabav ya aayatan mein se kisi se bhi poori tarah svatantra nahi hoti. Exam point: absolute humidity kisi ek gun se svatantra nahi hoti - ye paani ki nishchit matara batalati hai aur tapman tatha dabav ke saath badalti hai.

qe: What is 'Coefficient of Performance' (COP) for a Heat Pump?
qh: हीट पंप के लिए 'निष्पादन गुणांक' (COP) क्या है?
e: Heat pump bhi bas ek ulta chalaaya jaane wala refrigerator jaisa hoga: ye bahari thandi hawa se heat QH (usable heat) nikaal kar kamre mein deta hai, aur iske liye compressor mein W kaam lagta hai; isliye uska coefficient of performance COP = QH/W hota hai. Achhe heat pump ka COP 1 se kaafi adhik ho sakta hai (jaise 3), isliye ye bijli ke ek unit ke badle teen unit garmi deta hai. Refrigerator ke liye COP = Q2/W hota hai, isliye QH/W wala roop seedha heat pump ka hai (kyunki yahan kaam ke badle di gai heat adhik maayne rakhti hai). Exam point: heat pump ka COP = QH/W hota hai - yani compressor ke kaam ke badle kamre mein kitni heat pahunchti hai.

qe: What is 'Clausius inequality' related to?
qh: 'क्लॉसियस असमानता' किससे संबंधित है?
e: Clausius inequality kehti hai ki kisi bhi chakra (cycle) ke liye saare seemit (cyclic) heat transfers ko tapman se bhaag dene ka jod hamesha shunya ya usse kam hota hai. Isi asamaanata se ye nikalta hai ki jo raashi badalti hai wo entropy hai (isliye ye entropy ki paribhasha tatha uske badhne ke niyam ki jad hai). Iske ulat, enthalpy, Gibbs urja ya aantarik urja par ye asamaanata seedha nahi lagti. Exam point: Clausius inequality ka seedha sambandh entropy se hai - isse hi ye siddh hota hai ki vastavik (irreversible) kriyaon mein entropy badhti hai.

qe: What is 'Specific Volume'?
qh: 'विशिष्ट आयतन' क्या है?
e: Specific volume ka matlab hai ek unit dravyaman (mass) dwara ghere gae aayatan ka anupat, yani specific volume = aayatan/dravyaman (Volume/Mass). Ye ghanatva ka ulta hota hai (isliye ghanatva = 1/specific volume), isiliye bhaap tables aur thermodynamics mein iska bahut istemal hota hai (jaise 1 kg bhaap kitna ghan metre jagah leti hai). Iski SI ikai m3/kg hoti hai. Iske ulat, volume/area ya mass/volume jaisi raashiyan iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: specific volume = aayatan (volume) / dravyaman (mass) hota hai; iski ikai m3/kg tatha ye ghanatva ka vyutkram hota hai.

qe: In which process is 'No Heat' exchanged?
qh: किस प्रक्रिया में 'कोई ऊष्मा' विनिमय नहीं होती?
e: Adiabatic process mein kisi bhi roop me heat ka aadan-pradan nahi hota, isliye q = 0 hota hai - yani garmi ka koi exchange nahi hota aur kaam karne se aantarik urja se hi urja li jaati hai. Isi karan gas ka jaldi dabakar chhodna ya bhaap ko insulated nal mein failna aise hi process hote hain. Isothermal (sthir tapman), isobaric (sthir dabav) tatha isochoric (sthir aayatan) anya process hain, inme koi 'no heat' ki shart nahi hoti. Exam point: jis process mein bangalan heat exchange nahi hota = adiabatic process (q = 0), jisme Delta U = w hota hai.

qe: What is 'Black Body' radiation spectrum dependent on?
qh: 'कृष्ण पिंड' विकिरण स्पेक्ट्रम किस पर निर्भर करता है?
e: Black body dwara chhodi gayi radiation ka spectrum keval uske tapman par nirbhar karta hai - tapman badhne par adhiktam urja ki tarangdairdhya chhoti (neeche ki or) khisak jaati hai tatha kul urja T^4 ke anusar badh jaati hai. Isi karan loha garam hone par pehle laal, phir peela tatha safed hota hai (Wien's displacement law). Iski sanrachna, aakaar ya uske bhaar ka is spectrum par koi asar nahi hota. Isliye 'temperature only' hi iska sahi jod hai, aakaar ya material nahi. Exam point: black body ke radiation spectrum keval uske tapman par nirbhar karta hai; tapman badhne par rang badalne ka asar Wien's law se samajh aata hai.

qe: What is 'Joule-Thomson' coefficient for an ideal gas?
qh: एक आदर्श गैस के लिए 'जूल-थॉमसन' गुणांक क्या है?
e: Aadarsh gas (ideal gas) ke liye Joule-Thomson coefficient (mu) ka maan shunya hota hai - kyunki ideal gas ke anuon ke beech koi aakarshan bal nahi hota tatha uski aantarik urja keval tapman par nirbhar karti hai, isliye chhidra (pinhole) se guzarne par bhi uska tapman nahi badalta. Isliye koi thandak ya garami paida nahi hoti. Vastavik (real) gases ke liye mu ka maan kuchh dhan (thandak) ya rin (garami) hota hai - isi gun se hydrogen tatha helium ko neeche tapman par rakha jaata hai. Isliye is ideal gas wale prashn mein shunya aankda hi sahi hai. Exam point: ideal gas ka Joule-Thomson coefficient shunya hota hai (tapman nahi badalta), vastavik gas mein ye dhan ya rin ho sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Thermal Resistance' formula?
qh: 'ऊष्मीय प्रतिरोध' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Kisi bhi satah se garmi ke bahav ko rukawat ki tarah roka jaata hai, jise thermal resistance kehte hain; iski paribhasha R = L / (k x A) hoti hai, jahan L deewar ki motai, k padarth ki thermal conductivity tatha A kshetrafal hai (isi tarah vidyut ke Ohms law R = V/I ka anukaran). Isliye moti deewar tatha kam conductivity wala padarth zyada rukawat dete hain. Iska matrak kelvin per watt (K/W) hota hai. L/(kA) hi sahi roop hai, k x A / L ya L x k / A jaise jod ganit ke hisaab se galat hain. Exam point: thermal resistance = L/(kA) hoti hai; motai badhne ya conductivity ghatne par rukawat badhti hai.

qe: What happens to 'Viscosity' of gases with increase in 'Temperature'?
qh: 'तापमान' बढ़ने पर गैसों की 'श्यानता' (Viscosity) का क्या होता है?
e: Gas ke tapman ka matlab uske anuon ki ausat gati-urja hoti hai; tapman badhne par anu tez chalte hain isliye wo pari (layer) ke beech zyada samveg (momentum) ka aadan-pradan karte hain - isi karan gas ki viscosity (shyaanata) tapman ke saath badhti hai. Iske ulat drav ki viscosity tapman badhne par ghatti hai (jaise garam tel patla ho jaata hai), kyunki wahan anuon ka aakarshan bal kam hota hai. Isi farq ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai: gas badhti hai, drav ghatti hai. Isliye 'ghatti hai' ya 'same rehti hai' wale kathan gas ke liye galat hain. Exam point: gas ki viscosity tapman badhne par badhti hai (anuo ki gati badhne se), jabki drav ki viscosity ghatti hai.

qe: What is 'Stefan's Law' constant ($\sigma$) value?
qh: 'स्टीफन नियम' नियतांक ($\sigma$) का मान क्या है?
e: Stefan-Boltzmann constant ka maan 5.67 x 10^-8 hota hai aur iski ikai W per square metre per K^4 (W/m2.K4) hoti hai - yani ye chhodi gayi urja tatha tapman ki chauthi ghat ke beech ka pul hai. E = sigma x T^4 mein isi sankhya ko rakhne par chhodi gayi urja ka maan per square metre per second mil jaata hai. Isse yahi pata chalta hai ki tapman bahut chhoti matara mein badalne par bhi urja ka kitna bada badlav hota hai. Isliye 5.67 x 10^-8 hi iska sahi value hai, 5.67 ya 10^-8 jaise alag aankde iski poori sound nahi hain. Exam point: Stefan-Boltzmann constant sigma = 5.67 x 10^-8 W/m2.K4 hota hai - ise E = sigma T^4 mein istemal karte hain.

qe: Which color is a 'Poor' absorber of heat?
qh: कौन सा रंग ऊष्मा का 'खराब' अवशोषक है?
e: Rang ka 'absorber' hona us padarth ki satah par roshni ko sokhne ke gun se juda hota hai - safed rang poori roshni ko wapas paravartit kar deta hai, isliye wo garmi ka khrabz (poor) absorber hota hai (aur achha reflector hota hai). Isi karan garmi mein safed kapde pehne jaate hain tatha safed rang ki gaadi ka interior kam garam hota hai. Kaala rang sabse achha absorber hota hai, aur laal-neela-peela beech raaste par aate hain. Yeh baat radiation tatha Kirchhoff ke niyam tatha barf ka pighalna isi karan hota hai. Exam point: safed rang garmi ka khrabz (poor) absorber hota hai - wo zyada roshni paravartit karta hai, isliye khrabz sokhta hai.

qe: What is 'Latent Heat' of vaporization of water approximately?
qh: पानी के वाष्पीकरण की 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' लगभग कितनी है?
e: Ek gram paani ko uske kvathank par bhaap mein badalne ke liye lagbhag 540 calorie chahiye - yani 2.26 x 10^6 joule per kilogram; ye urja tapman ko badhaye bina hi kharch ho jaati hai. Isi karan paseena bhaap ban kar bahut urja le jaata hai aur shareer thanda hota hai, tatha bhaap se jalne par chot 100 degree C paani se zyada gehri hoti hai (kyunki bhaap mein chhipi urja bhi chhut.ti hai). 80 cal/g paani ki fusion ki latent heat hai, isliye wo aankda vaporization ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: bhaap mein chhipi ushma paani ke liye lagbhag 540 calorie per gram hoti hai (2.26 x 10^6 J/kg) - yahi paseene ko itna prabhavi thanda-karak banati hai.

qe: What is 'Critical State' pressure for water?
qh: पानी के लिए 'क्रांतिक अवस्था' दाब क्या है?
e: Paani ka critical pressure lagbhag 221 bar (yani 218 atmosphere ya 22 MPa) hota hai; is seema ke paar jaane par paani ek hi mishrit roop mein reh jaata hai jismein drav tatha vapasheel avastha alag nahi hoti. Isi karan uitpadan ke bhaap-bhatti (boiler) 200-250 bar tak kaam karte hain - par usse upar jaane par bhaap banna band ho jaata hai, kyunki bhaap banane ke liye drav-gas ka antar hi nahi rahta. Isliye 1 bar ya 100 bar jaise aankde yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: paani ka critical pressure lagbhag 221 bar (yani 218 atm) hota hai; is seema par pahunchne par drav tatha vapasheel roop ka antar mit jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Freezing Mixture' usually composed of?
qh: 'हिमकारी मिश्रण' (Freezing Mixture) आमतौर पर किससे बना होता है?
o: Ice and Salt | बर्फ और नमक
e: Freezing mixture (hima-mishran) saadharan taur par barf tatha namak (ice + common salt) ka mishran hota hai - namak barf par pada rehta hai to barf pighalne ke liye usse urja leni padti hai, jisse wo khud bahut thanda ho jaata hai (0 degree C se neeche, lagbhag -20 degree C tak). Isi karan aaj bhi ice cream banane tatha purane tarike ke freezer mein ye mishran istemal hoti hai. Kevan barf ya barf-sugar ka mishran itna thanda nahi hota, isliye namak ka hona zaroori hai. Exam point: freezing mixture barf tatha namak ka mishran hota hai - namak ke karan barf pighal kar khud bahut thanda (0 se neeche) ho jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Reversible' process?
qh: 'उत्क्रमणीय' प्रक्रिया क्या है?
o: Quasi-static and frictionless | अर्ध-स्थैतिक और घर्षण रहित
e: Reversible process wo aadarsh process hai jismein kriya itne dheere-dheere (quasi-static) tatha bina gharsh (friction) ke hoti hai ki har pad par tantra lagbhag santulan mein rehta hai, isliye kriya ko usi marg se ulta (reverse) kiya ja sakta hai tatha tantra tatha charon-aur dono apni purani avastha mein wapas aa sakte hain. Isi karan ismein entropy ka badlav shunya hota hai tatha adhiktam (maximum) kaam nikaala ja sakta hai. Iske ulat asanrakshit (irreversible) process mein friction ya seemit dabav-antar hota hai, isliye wo wapas nahi hota. Exam point: reversible process quasi-static (dheema-santulit) tatha gharshan-rahit hoti hai - isi karan ye adhiktam kaam deti hai.

qe: What is 'Kelvin-Planck' statement related to?
qh: 'केल्विन-प्लैंक' कथन किससे संबंधित है?
e: Kelvin-Planck kathan doosre niyam ka wo roop hai jo heat engine se juda hai - iske anusar ek chakra (cycle) mein kaam karte hue engine ke liye ye sambhav nahi ki wo sirf ek hi bhandar (reservoir) se poori heat le aur ushe poora kaam mein badal de; kuchh heat sink ko chhodni hi padti hai. Isliye 100% efficiency wala engine sambhav nahi (jo doosre niyam ka aadhaar hai). Clausius kathan heat pump tatha refrigerator se juda hai (garmi ka ulta bahav), isliye ushe is prashn se alag rakhen. Exam point: Kelvin-Planck kathan heat engines se sambandhit hai - iske anusar ek hi bhandar se poori heat lekar 100% kaam paana asambhav hai.

qe: What is 'Internal Energy' of an ideal gas dependent on?
qh: एक आदर्श गैस की 'आंतरिक ऊर्जा' किस पर निर्भर करती है?
e: Is gas ki andaruni urja ka nirnay sirf uske tapman se hota hai; aayatan ya dabav badalne ka koi seedha asar uske maan par nahi padta - isliye sthir tapman wale process mein ye urja wahi rehti hai, chaahe gas fail ho ya sikud jaaye. Vastavik gas mein anuon ke beech aakarshan tatha unka aayatan hone ke karan aantarik urja thoda aayatan par bhi nirbhar karti hai. Isi karan aadarsh gas ke liye U = f(T) likha jaata hai aur isse gamit aasaan ho jaata hai. Isliye 'aayatan' ya 'dabav' par nirbhar hona aadarsh gas ke liye sahih nahi. Exam point: aadarsh gas ki andaruni urja ka nirnay keval tapman se hota hai (uske maan par aayatan tatha dabav ka seedha asar nahi padta).

qe: What is 'Prevost's theory' of heat exchange?
qh: प्रेवोस्ट का ऊष्मा विनिमय सिद्धांत क्या है?
o: Bodies emit and absorb at all temperatures | पिंड सभी तापमानों पर उत्सर्जित और अवशोषित करते हैं
e: Prevost's theory (Heat exchange ka siddhant) kehta hai ki pratyek pind (body) har tapman par ushma (radiation) chhodta tatha sokhta rehta hai - kuchh garam pind zyada chhodta hai aur kuchh kam, isliye net bahav ki disha hi tapman ka antar tay karta hai. Iska matlab ye hai ki 'thanda pind sirf leta hai' wala purana vichaar galat hai. Net bahav ke kaaran hi thanda pind garam hota tatha garam thanda. Isi siddhant ke aadhaar par Stefan ka niyam tatha heat exchange ka poora ganit tika hai. Exam point: Prevost ke siddhant ke anusar pratyek pind har tapman par ushma chhodta tatha sokhta hai; net bahav sirf tapman ke antar se tay hota hai.

qe: What is 'Stefan-Boltzmann' law formula?
qh: 'स्टीफन-बोल्ट्जमैन' नियम का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Stefan-Boltzmann niyam ka samikaran E = sigma x T^4 hota hai, jahan E prati second prati square metre nikalne wali urja, sigma Stefan-Boltzmann constant tatha T paramm tapman (kelvin) hai. Isi samikaran se pata chalta hai ki tapman gulab (double) karne par nikalne wali urja solaha (16) guna ho jaati hai - yahi asar suraj, bulb aur star ka tapman nikaalne mein kaam aata hai. E = mc^2 (urja-dravyaman), E = P x t (vidyut urja) aur PV = nRT (gas samikaran) alag vishay hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Stefan-Boltzmann ka samikaran E = sigma T^4 hai - chhodi gayi urja paramm tapman ki chauthi ghat ke samanupati hoti hai.

qe: Which instrument is used to measure 'Low' temperatures near absolute zero?
qh: परम शून्य के पास 'कम' तापमान मापने के लिए किसका उपयोग होता है?
e: Nirapeksh shunya (absolute zero) ke aas-paas ka bahut kam tapman saadharan thermometer se nahi maapa ja sakta, isliye wahan magnetic thermometer ka istemal hota hai - ismein ek param-chumbakiya padarth (jaise gadolinium sulfate) ki chumbakta (magnetic susceptibility) tapman ke saath badalti hai, jise maap kar tapman nikaala jaata hai. Isi karan ise 1 K (yahan tak ki millikelvin) tak ke tapman maapne ke liye istemal karte hain. Mercury thermometer bahut kam tapman par jama ho jaata hai aur thermocouple bhi itna sateek nahi hota. Exam point: absolute zero ke paas ke tapman maapne ke liye magnetic thermometer istemal hota hai, jo chumbakta ke badlav se nimn tapman bataata hai.

qe: What is 'Adiabatic Index' ($\gamma$) for monatomic gas?
qh: एक-परमाणुक गैस के लिए 'रुद्धोष्म सूचकांक' ($\gamma$) क्या है?
e: Monoatomic gas (jaise helium, neon, argon) ke atom keval ek bindu ki tarah sthanantaran (translation) karte hain, isliye unki chalne ki azaadi sirf teen dishaon mein hoti hai - isse Cv = 3R/2 tatha Cp = 5R/2 nikalta hai, isliye adiabatic index gamma = Cp/Cv = 5/3 = 1.67 hota hai. Iske ulat dwiparmaanvik gas ka 1.4 tatha bahuparmaanvik ka 1.33 hota hai, isliye wo aankde monoatomic ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: monoatomic gas ka adiabatic index gamma = 1.67 (5/3) hota hai, kyunki uske atom keval teen dishaon mein sthanantaran kar sakte hain.

qe: What is 'Conduction' primarily in?
qh: 'चालन' मुख्य रूप से किसमें होता है?
e: Conduction (ushma-chaalakta dwara garmi ka bahav) mukhya roop se thos padarthon mein hota hai, kyunki thos ke anu paas-paas bandhe hote hain aur dhaatuon mein mukta electron bhi chalte hain - isliye ek sira garam karne par doosra sira bhi garam ho jaata hai (jaise loha ki chhadi). Dravon mein ye bahav kam hota hai aur gases mein to bahut kam (usme convection prabal hota hai), isliye wahan aksar conduction ke saath-saath convection bhi chalta hai. Isliye 'solids' hi iska mukhya kshetr hai. Exam point: conduction mukhya roop se thos (solids) mein hota hai - anuon ke bandhan tatha mukta electron ke karan garmi bina padarth ke chale aage jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Isothermal' elasticity of a gas?
qh: गैस की 'समतापी' प्रत्यास्थता क्या है?
e: Kisi gas ki isothermal elasticity (sthir tapman par dabav tatha aayatan ke badlav ka anupat) dabav (P) ke barabar hoti hai - kyunki sthir tapman par PV = sthir hone se dabav jitne se badhega, aayatan utne hi anupat mein ghat jayega. Iske ulat, adiabatic elasticity gamma x P hoti hai (yani isothermal se gamma guna adhik). Isi karan dhaunkan (sound) ki speed nikaalne ke liye adiabatic elasticity istemal hoti hai. Isliye 'P' hi sahi jod hai, na ki 2P ya P/2. Exam point: gas ki isothermal elasticity = dabav (P) hoti hai, jabki adiabatic elasticity = gamma x P hoti hai (isliye sound ki speed ka ganit adiabatic se hota hai).

qe: What is 'Sea Breeze' caused by?
qh: 'समुद्र समीर' (Sea Breeze) किसके कारण चलती है?
e: Samudra ke paas din mein zameen jaldi garam tatha raat mein jaldi thandi hoti hai, par paani ka tapman dheere badalta hai - isi farq ke karan din mein zameen ki garam hawa upar uthti hai aur samudra ki thandi hawa zameen ki or aati hai, jise 'sea breeze' kehte hain. Raat mein ulta asar (land breeze) hota hai. Yahi kriya convection ke chakra (density difference) ka saaf udaharan hai, isliye sea breeze ka mukhya kaaran convection hai - conduction, radiation ya induction nahi. Exam point: sea breeze convention (samvahan) ke karan chalti hai - zameen aur samudra ke tapman ke antar se hawa ka chakra banta hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Density' of water at?
qh: पानी का 'अधिकतम घनत्व' किस तापमान पर होता है?
e: Paani ka ghanatva 4 degree C par sabse adhik (1 g/cm3) hota hai - kyunki 4 degree C se upar tapman badhne par paani failta hai tatha 4 degree C se neeche jaane par uski khuli hydrogen-bond wali dhancha banna shuru hota hai jismein aur khaali jagah hoti hai. Isi karan barf paani par tairti hai tatha geli talab mein jeev sabse neeche (upar ki barf ke neeche 4 degree C ke paani mein) bache rehte hain. Isi karan '0 degree C' ya '100 degree C' jaise maan yahan galat hota (ye do anya tapman hain). Exam point: paani ka maximum density 4 degree C par hota hai - yahi karan hai ki barf paani par tairti hai aur 4 degree C ke paani mein jeev bachte hain.

qe: Which law relates the 'Pressure' and 'Temperature' of a gas at constant volume?
qh: स्थिर आयतन पर गैस के 'दाब' और 'तापमान' के बीच कौन सा नियम संबंध बताता है?
e: Gay-Lussac's law (pressure law) kehta hai ki sthir aayatan par kisi gas ka dabav uske paramm tapman (kelvin) ke samanupati hota hai, isliye P1/T1 = P2/T2 hota hai; isi karan bandh bartan ko garam karne par andar ka dabav badh jaata hai (pressure cooker/cylinder ka siddhant). Boyle ke niyam mein tapman sthir tatha aayatan-dabav badalte hain, aur Charles ke niyam mein dabav sthir hota hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: sthir aayatan par dabav tatha tapman ka sambandh Gay-Lussac's law (P1/T1 = P2/T2) se hota hai; isi liye bandh bartan garam karne par dabav badhta hai.

qe: What is 'Bolometer' used to measure?
qh: 'बोलोमीटर' का उपयोग क्या मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Bolometer ek atyant sankhshipt (sensitive) yantra hai jo aane wali ushma-vaikiran (thermal radiation) ki matara maap leta hai - iske andar ek kaali patli parat hoti hai jiska pratirodhak (resistance) tapman ke saath badalta hai, isliye vaikiran padne se bane chhote tapman-antar se ye urja ka maan bata deta hai. Isi karan ise upekshit (distant) padarthon ki vaikiran tatha lamp ki urja maapne mein istemal karte hain. Tapman-sthirata ya aayatan-nirman ka kaam is yantra ka nahi hai. Exam point: bolometer thermal radiation (ushma-vaikiran) maapne ka yantra hai - ye resistance ke badlav se vaikiran ki matara ka pata deta hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Melting Point' of wax when pressure is increased?
qh: दाब बढ़ाने पर मोम के 'गलनांक' पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Mom-batti (wax) garam hone par pighalti hai aur fail jaati hai (yani uski drav avastha thos roop se zyada jagah ghere hue hoti hai); isliye bahari dabav badhane par wahi badlav ruk jaata hai jismein jagah ghatti hai - matlab pighalna mushkil ho jaata hai aur galaank upar chala jaata hai. Iske ulat paani ek khaas apavaad hai: uska thos roop drav roop se zyada jagah leta hai, isliye wahan dabav ka asar ulta hone se barf pighal jaati hai. Isi farq ke karan wax ke mould dabav mein theek rehte hain par barf pighal jaati hai. Exam point: dabav badhane par mom-batti ka galaank upar jaata hai, kyunki wax pighal kar failti hai (paani mein ye asar ulta dikhta hai).

qe: What is 'Absolute Zero' theoretically?
qh: सैद्धांतिक रूप से 'परम शून्य' क्या है?
o: Temperature where all motion stops | वह तापमान जहाँ सारी आणविक गति रुक जाती है
e: Nirapeksh shunya (absolute zero) ek aadarsh (theoretical) seema hai jahan anuon ki sabhi gati lagbhag ruk jaayegi - isliye ise wo tapman kaha jaata hai jahan aaniye gati ki nyoonatam seema aati hai; iski value -273.15 degree C (0 K) hai. Vyavhar mein ye tapman aaj tak poora nahi paaya gaya (haan, 0 K ke bahut kareeb tak pahuncha gaya hai), kyunki quantum niyam ke karan thodi gati bachi rehti hai. Isi karan ise 'theoretically' kaha jaata hai, kisi chhu-pe (reachable) aankde ke roop mein nahi. Exam point: absolute zero = wo theoretical tapman (-273.15 degree C) jahan aaniye gati lagbhag ruk jaati hai; vyavhar mein ye pura nahi paaya ja sakta.
