qe: Which mode of heat transfer does not require any 'Medium'?
qh: ऊष्मा संचरण की किस विधि में किसी 'माध्यम' की आवश्यकता नहीं होती?
e: Garmi ke teen tarikon mein se radiation hi ekmatr aisa tarika hai jo bina kisi madhyam (medium) ke chal sakta hai - kyunki ye vidyut-chumbakiya tarangon (infraraid) ke roop mein chalti hai, isliye surya ki garmi khali space (vacuum) se guzar kar dharti tak pahunchti hai. Conduction tatha convection ke liye kisi padarth (thos/drav/gas) ka hona zaroori hai, isliye wo nirvaat (vacuum) mein nahi chal sakte. Thermos flask isi gun ka fayda uthata hai - uske khaali bhaag se radiation ke alawa koi garmi ka raasta nahi bachta. Exam point: bina madhyam chalan wala heat transfer = radiation (vaikiran); conduction aur convection ke liye madhyam zaroori hota hai.

qe: What is 'Thermal Conductivity' of Silver compared to Wood?
qh: लकड़ी की तुलना में चांदी की 'तापीय चालकता' क्या है?
e: Chandi ki thermal conductivity lagbhag 429 W/m.K hoti hai, jo lakdi (lagbhag 0.15) se lagbhag 3000 guna adhik hoti hai - isliye tasveer se saaf hai ki dhaatu chaalak hote hain aur lakdi insulator. Chandi ke mukhya karan uske anuon ke bahari kosh ke bahut se mukta electron hote hain, jo garmi ko tezi se aage le jaate hain; lakdi mein electron svatantra nahi chalte, isliye wo garmi ko rok leti hai (isliye lakdi ka danda pakad kar garam taava pakda ja sakta hai). Exam point: chandi ki thermal conductivity lakdi ki tulna mein bahut adhik hoti hai - isliye dhaatu garmi ke achhe chaalak tatha lakdi kamzor chaalak hoti hai.

qe: Why do 'Cloudy Nights' feel warmer than clear nights?
qh: 'बादल वाली रातें' साफ रातों की तुलना में गर्म क्यों महसूस होती हैं?
o: Clouds reflect terrestrial radiation | बादल पार्थिव विकिरण को वापस परावर्तित करते हैं
e: Badal (clouds) ke honay wali raat zameen tatha hawa se nikalne wali parthiv vaikiran (terrestrial radiation) ko wapas paravartit kar dete hain, isliye garmi aasman mein chali nahi jaati aur raat kam thandi lagti hai - isi karan badli raaton (cloudy nights) mein saayankal (frost) nahi padta. Iske ulat saaf raat mein vaikiran seedha space mein chala jaata hai, isliye zameen tezi se thandi ho jaati hai (isliye saaf raat mein maayus/frost padta hai). Yeh baat greenhouse effect ke siddhant se bhi judti hai. Exam point: badli raat garm kyuni lagti hai - kyunki badal parthiv vaikiran ko wapas paravartit karke garmi ko rok dete hain.

qe: What is 'Clausius-Clapeyron' equation used to determine?
qh: 'क्लॉसियस-क्लेपेरॉन' समीकरण का उपयोग क्या निर्धारित करने के लिए होता है?
o: Variation of saturation pressure with temp | तापमान के साथ संतृप्ति दाब का परिवर्तन
e: Clausius-Clapeyron samikaran kisi bhi padarth ke santript (saturation) dabav tatha tapman ke beech ka sambandh batati hai, isliye isse ye pata chalta hai ki tapman badhne par santript vapours ka dabav kitna badhta hai (ya pighalne/kvathank ke badlav ka ganit hota hai). Isi samikaran se bhaap bhatti (boiler), vapour-compression system tatha khadkhadne (bhaap ke dabav se) wale padarthon ka ganit nikaala jaata hai; graaf ka dhalan (slope) latent heat ka pata deta hai. Padarth ka thos-bhaar ya rang nikaalne mein iska istemal nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Clausius-Clapeyron samikaran tapman ke saath santript dabav (saturation pressure) ka badlav nikaalti hai - isi se vashpeekaran tatha kvathank ka ganit bana hai.

qe: What is the unit of 'Entropy' in SI?
qh: SI में 'एन्ट्रॉपी' का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Entropy (S) urja tatha tapman ka anupat hone ke karan uski SI ikai joule per kelvin (J/K) hoti hai - yani jab tantra ko q(rev) urja milti hai to entropy ka badlav q/T hota hai. Ise vikhepank (disorder) ka maap kehte hain, isliye iska dhan hona vikhepank badhne ki or ishaara karta hai. Kisi dhaatu ki vishesh ushma ka maap J/kg.K hota hai aur sada urja ka maap J - entropy in dono se alag hai, kyunki yahan urja ko tapman se bhaag diya jaata hai (yani iska matrak urja/tapman hai). Exam point: entropy ki SI ikai J/K (joule per kelvin) hoti hai, kyunki S = q(rev)/T tatha ye vikhepank (disorder) ka maap hai.

qe: What is 'Triple Point' pressure of Water?
qh: पानी का 'त्रिक बिंदु' दाब क्या है?
e: Paani ka triple point dabav lagbhag 611.65 pascal (yani 0.006 atm) hota hai - is nishchit tapman (273.16 K) tatha dabav par paani ki thos, drav tatha bhaap teeno avasthaayein santulan mein rehti hain. Isi karan phase diagram mein ye nishchit bindu se pata chalta hai ki kis dabav se neeche barf seedha sublimation karegi (us dabav se upar pighal kar paani banega). 1 atm (samundar-tal ka dabav) isse lagbhag 165 guna adhik hai, isliye 1 atm ke dabav par paani ka tribindu nahi milta. Exam point: paani ka triple point dabav lagbhag 611.65 Pa (0.006 atm) hota hai - us par thos, drav tatha vapasheel teeno avasthaayein ek saath rehti hain.

qe: Which 'Law' defines the temperature scale?
qh: कौन सा 'नियम' तापमान के पैमाने को परिभाषित करता है?
e: Zeroth law of thermodynamics kehta hai ki agar do tantra kisi teesre tantra ke saath thermal santulan mein hain, to wo aapas mein bhi santulan mein honge - isi kathan se tapman ki dhaarna (concept) banti hai tatha ye tay hota hai ki tapman ke maap ke liye thermometer istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Isliye temperature scale tatha uski niyamita (calibration) zeroth law se tay hoti hai; isi karan ise baaki niyamon se pehle rakha jaata hai. First law urja sanrakshan, second law entropy aur third law 0 K par entropy ke baare mein hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: temperature scale (tapman paimana) zeroth law of thermodynamics se tay hota hai - isi se thermometer ka siddhant banta hai.

qe: What is 'Adiabatic Index' ($\gamma$) for a Triatomic (linear) gas?
qh: एक त्रि-परमाणुक (रैखीय) गैस के लिए 'रुद्धोष्म सूचकांक' ($\gamma$) क्या है?
e: Linear triatomic gas (jaise carbon dioxide) ke teen atom ek seedhi line mein lage hote hain, isliye aise anu ke paas 3 sthanantaran (translation) tatha 2 ghoornan (rotation) - kul 5 swatantrata koti (degrees of freedom) hoti hain. In azaadi-dishaon se molar ushmaon ka anupat nikalta hai, isliye adiabatic index ki value 7/5 = 1.4 ban jaati hai. Non-linear triatomic gas (jaise paani ki bhaap) ke liye 3 ghoornan sahi hone se gamma 1.33 ban jaata hai, aur ek atom wali gas ke liye 1.67 hota hai - isliye '1.4' hi linear roop ka uttar hai. Iske ulat 1.67 monoatomic ka aankda hai, isliye yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: linear triatomic gas (CO2) ka adiabatic index 1.4 (7/5) hota hai, kyunki uski 5 azaadi-dishayein (3 translation + 2 rotation) hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of a substance at its 'Boiling Point'?
qh: अपने 'क्वथनांक' पर किसी पदार्थ की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या होती है?
e: Kisi padarth ka galaank ya kvathank par tapman nahi badalta - di gai poori heat avastha badalne mein kharch hoti hai (gupat ushma). Chunki ayatanik ushma ka sutra c = Q/(m x Delta T) hai aur yahan Delta T ka maan shunya ho jaata hai jabki heat dene par bhi avastha badalti rehti hai, isliye hisaab se c ka maan 'anant' (infinite) nikalta hai. Iska arth ye nahi ki padarth heat leta hi nahi - wo bahut heat leta hai par tapman sthir rehta hai, isliye ek chhoti heat ke liye bada maan nahi maanga ja sakta. Isi liye boiler tatha barf pighalne ke hisaab mein latent heat ka istemal karte hain. Exam point: kvathank par padarth ki specific heat anant maani jaati hai, kyunki heat dene par bhi tapman nahi badalta (poori heat avastha badalne mein lagti hai).

qe: What is 'Mayer's relation' for 1 mole of gas?
qh: 1 मोल गैस के लिए 'मेयर का संबंध' क्या है?
e: Ek mole gas ke liye Mayer ka sambandh Cp - Cv = R kehta hai ki sthir dabav wali molar ushma tatha sthir ayatan wali molar ushma ka antar gas constant R (8.314 J/mol.K) ke barabar hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sthir dabav par gas garam hone ke saath failta bhi hai, isliye di gai heat ka ek hissa bahari kaam (P.Delta V = R.Delta T) mein kharch ho jaata hai; sthir ayatan par aisa kaam nahi hota. Isliye Cp hamesha Cv se bada hota hai tatha aadarsh gas ke liye unka antar sthir rehta hai. Isi sambandh se R nikaalne ka prayog bhi hota hai. Exam point: one mole ke liye Cp - Cv = R hota hai; sthir dabav par extra heat gas ke failne ke kaam mein lagti hai.

qe: Which instrument measures 'Solar Radiation' intensity?
qh: 'सौर विकिरण' की तीव्रता कौन सा उपकरण मापता है?
e: Pyranometer ek aisa upkaran hai jo surya se aane wali kul vaikiran (solar radiation) ki tezata maapta hai, isliye iski ikai watt per square metre hoti hai. Iske andar ki kaali satah chhote samay mein ushma banati hai tatha tapman-antar se vaikiran ka flux nikaala jaata hai; meterological station tatha solar panel ke adhyayan mein yahi yantra sabse aam hai. Seedhi dhoop ki kiran (direct beam) maapne wale yantra ko pyrheliometer kehte hain, aur bulb ki urja maapne wale ko bolometer - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Isse pata chalta hai ki alag-alag yantra alag-alag roop ki vaikiran ke liye bane hote hain. Exam point: solar radiation ki intensity pyranometer se maapi jaati hai (ikai W/m2); sirf seedhi kiran ke liye pyrheliometer istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Conduction' of heat in gases primarily due to?
qh: गैसों में ऊष्मा का 'चालन' मुख्य रूप से किसके कारण होता है?
e: Gases mein conduction mukhya roop se anuon ki takkar (molecular collisions) se hota hai, kyunki gas mein mukta electron nahi hote tatha anu ek doosre se door rehte hain; ek garam anu takra kar apni urja agli anu ko de deta hai. Isi karan gases bahut khrabz chaalak hote hain (hawa, CO2 jaise padarth thermos flask mein insulators ka kaam karte hain). Uchch tapman par anu tez chalte hain, par unki sankhya vaise hi rehti hai, isliye saadharan dabav-parisare mein gas ki conductivity lagbhag sthir rehti hai. Dhaatu mein conduction ke saath-saath electron ka bhi bada hissa hota hai, isliye gases ka roop alag hai. Exam point: gases mein conduction anuon ki takkar dwara hota hai (mukta electron ke bina), isliye gasen khrabz ushma-chaalak hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Joule-Thomson' effect zero for?
qh: 'जूल-थॉमसन' प्रभाव किसके लिए शून्य होता है?
e: Joule-Thomson gunank aadarsh gas ke liye poora shunya rehta hai, kyunki aise gas ke kanon ke beech na aakarshan na vikarshan bal hota hai tatha unki andaruni urja tapman ke alaava kisi anya gun par nahi tikti; isliye ushe patli chhidra se guzaarne par tapman jara bhi nahi badalta - na thandak banti hai na garami. Vastavik gases ke liye ye gunank shunya se alag hota hai; hydrogen tatha helium garam hote hain jabki nitrogen-oxygen jaise baaki gases thandi hote hain. Isi gun se drav hawai-gas plants ka kaam chalta hai. Exam point: aadarsh gas ke liye ye gunank shunya hota hai, kyunki bina aakarshan-bal wali gas chhidra se guzarne par thandi ya garam nahi hoti.

qe: What is 'Latent Heat' of ice in SI units (approx)?
qh: SI मात्रक में बर्फ की 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' (लगभग) क्या है?
e: Barf ke pighalne ki gupat ushma lagbhag 334 kJ/kg hoti hai - yani 1 kilogram barf ko 0 degree C par paani banane ke liye itni urja lagti hai (calorie mein ye lagbhag 80 cal/g hota hai). Bhap banane ki gupat ushma isse kaafi adhik (2.26 x 10^6 J/kg = 540 cal/g) hoti hai, kyunki bhaap mein anuon ke beech ke poori tarah toote bandhan ki urja bhi lagti hai. Isi liye barf pighalne mein samay lagta hai tatha pighalti barf thanda rakhti hai. kJ/kg SI matrak hai, kelvin ya joule/mole anya roop hain jo is prashn ke prashnaadhar mein nahi aate. Exam point: barf ki gupat ushma lagbhag 334 kJ/kg (80 cal/g) hoti hai; ye avastha badalne ke liye chahiye, tapman badhane ke liye nahi.

qe: Why is 'Copper' used at the bottom of stainless steel pans?
qh: स्टेनलेस स्टील के बर्तनों के नीचे 'तांबे' का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: Better heat conductivity | बेहतर ऊष्मा चालकता
e: Stainless steel ki bhagoun (pan) ke niche tamba (copper) ki parat isliye lagai jaati hai ki tamba ushma ka bahut achha chaalak hai (lagbhag 400 W/m.K, jabki steel ka lagbhag 50 W/m.K) - isliye aasu-aasu garam hone wali jagah ki heat poori bhagoun mein faitt jaati hai tatha khaana jalne nahi lagta. Aisa na hone par steel ki bhagoun mein sirf ek jagah zyada garam ho jaati tatha khaana chipak jaata. Tamba pighalta bhi ek samaan tapman par hai, isliye ye bhagoun ke saath tikau rehta hai. Isi gun ke karan aajkal aluminium ki parat bhi istemal hoti hai. Exam point: steel ki bhagoun ke niche tamba isliye lagta hai ki tamba ki ushma-chaalakta bahut adhik hoti hai - isse heat poori tahi par barabar failti hai.

qe: What is the relation between '$\alpha$', '$\beta$', and '$\gamma$' for an isotropic solid?
qh: एक समदैशिक ठोस के लिए '$\alpha$', '$\beta$' और '$\gamma$' में क्या संबंध है?
e: Samangi (isotropic) thos padarth ke liye kshetrafal prasaar gunank (beta) tatha aayatan prasaar gunank (gamma) lambai prasaar gunank (alpha) ke seedha gunaj mein hote hain: beta = 2 alpha tatha gamma = 3 alpha, isliye anupat 1 : 2 : 3 hota hai. Iska ganit saaf hai - jab har lambai (1 + alpha x Delta T) guna badhti hai, to (1 + alpha x Delta T)^2 mein alpha ke chhote pad ko chhod dein to 1 + 2 alpha x Delta T milta hai, tatha ghan mein 1 + 3 alpha x Delta T. Isi karan tamba ki chadar patli hone se bhi failti hai per lambai wahi ghat-ti-badhti hai. Isliye 1 : 3 : 2 jaise jod yahan galat hain (kram sahi rakhna zaroori hai). Exam point: samangi thos ke liye alpha : beta : gamma = 1 : 2 : 3 hota hai, kyunki do-roop tatha teen-roop failav se ye anupat banta hai.

qe: What is 'Kirchhoff's Law' of radiation?
qh: विकिरण का 'किरचॉफ का नियम' क्या है?
o: Good absorbers are good emitters | अच्छे अवशोषक ही अच्छे उत्सर्जक होते हैं
e: Kirchhoff ke niyam ke anusar ek hi tapman par koi bhi satah kis matara mein vaikiran sokhti hai, usi anupat mein usi tarangdairdhya ki vaikiran chhodti bhi hai - yani achhe avshoshak (absorber) achhe utsargak (emitter) hote hain (a = e). Isi karan kaali satah sabse achhi sokhak tatha chhodne wali hoti hai, aur chamakdar (polished) satah dono kaam mein khrabz hoti hai. Iska sidha prayog is me hai ki uchch tapman par dhaatu rang par badal deta hai tatha greenhouse gasen infraraid vaikiran ko sokh chhod deti hain. Isi niyam ke aadhaar par hi black body ki kalpana aur uska vaikiran-spectrum samajh aata hai. Exam point: Kirchhoff ka niyam kehta hai ki achhe avshoshak achhe utsargak bhi hote hain - ek hi tapman par sokhna tatha chhodna barabar anupat mein hota hai.

qe: What is 'Prevost Theory' related to?
qh: 'प्रेवोस्ट सिद्धांत' किससे संबंधित है?
o: Heat exchange by radiation | विकिरण द्वारा ऊष्मा विनिमय
e: Prevost ke siddhant ke anusar sansar ka har pind har samay ushma-vaikiran chhodta tatha sokhta rehta hai - chahe wo garam ho ya thanda - isliye net roop se ushma ka bahav sirf dono pindon ke tapman ke antar se tay hota hai. Isi karan thanda pind bhi garam pind se kam vaikiran chhodta hai tatha garam pind usse adhik sokhta hai, isliye garam pind ka tapman girta hai. Yehi dhaarna 'sirf garam pind hi vaikiran chhodta hai' wale purane vichar ko galat saabit karti hai. Iske aadhaar par hi vaikiran (radiation) se hone wali ushma-vinimay ka ganit bana hai. Exam point: Prevost ka siddhant vaikiran ke zariye ushma-vinimay se juda hai - sabhi pind har tapman par vaikiran chhodte tatha sokhte hain, aur net bahav tapman-antar se tay hota hai.

qe: What is 'Efficiency' of a heat engine rejecting all heat to sink?
qh: सिंक को सारी ऊष्मा छोड़ने वाले इंजन की 'दक्षता' क्या होगी?
e: Isi engine se kaam paane ke liye heat ka ek hissa sada thande bhandar (sink) ko chhodna padta hai (doosre niyam ki shart). Yadi engine poori heat sink ko de de, to W = Q1 - Q2 = 0 ho jaata hai, isliye efficiency ka sutra eta = W/Q1 ka maan shunya aa jaata hai. Yani tantra bahut heat lekar bhi koi upyogi kaam nahi de paata - ye baat 100% efficiency wale engine ki sambhavna ko bhi kharij karti hai. Vyavhar mein ise 'sab heat chhod dene wala engine' kehte hain jo bilkul bekaar hai. Exam point: jo engine poori heat sink ko chhod deta hai uska efficiency zero hota hai, kyunki usse nikaala gaya kaam shunya hota hai.

qe: What is 'Isothermal' expansion work done for 1 mole?
qh: 1 मोल के लिए 'समतापी' प्रसार में किया गया कार्य क्या है?
e: Ek mole aadarsh gas ka tapman sthir rakh kar ushe V1 se V2 tak failaane par kiya gaya kaam RT ln(V2/V1) hota hai (yahan R gas constant, T paramm tapman tatha ln natural log hai). Ye sutra isliye banta hai ki isothermal process mein gas ka dabav girta rehta hai (P = nRT/V), isliye aayatan ke saath kaam ka jod (integration) log ke roop mein nikalta hai. Isi karan agar aayatan dugna (double) kar diya jaaye to kaam RT x 0.693 hota hai. nRT ln(...) bahu-gun (n mole) ke liye likha jaata hai, par ek mole par n = 1 hone se yahi RT ln(V2/V1) ban jaata hai. Exam point: ek mole ke isothermal failav mein kaam RT ln(V2/V1) hota hai; ye dabav ke girne ke saath chalne wali kriya ka jod hai.

qe: Which state of matter has the 'Maximum' intermolecular space?
qh: पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में 'अधिकतम' अंतर-आणविक स्थान होता है?
e: Padarth ki teen avasthaon mein gas ke anuon ke beech ki doori sabse adhik hoti hai - gas ke kan ek doosre se kafi faasle par tatha bina kisi bandhan ke tatol (random) gati karte rehte hain, isliye ushi matara ka padarth gas banne par sabse zyada jagah ghere hue hota hai (isliye gas aasaani se dabaya ja sakta hai). Drav mein anu paas aate hain par beh sakte hain, aur thos mein anu ek bandhi hui jali mein kas kar baithte hain, isliye wahan antar-anvik doori sabse kam hoti hai. Isi karan gas ka ghanatva sabse kam tatha thos ka sabse adhik hota hai. Isliye 'gas' hi sahi jod hai, thos ya drav nahi. Exam point: gas mein antar-anvik doori (intermolecular space) sabse adhik hoti hai - isliye gas aasaani se sikud sakti hai tatha usi bhaar mein sabse adhik aayatan ghere hue hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of the Stefan-Boltzmann constant?
qh: स्टीफन-बोल्ट्जमैन नियतांक का 'SI मात्रक' क्या है?
e: Stefan-Boltzmann niyam E = sigma x T^4 mein sigma ek sthir gunank hai; ismein E ki ikai W/m2 tatha T kelvin mein hota hai, isliye sigma ki ikai W/m2.K4 (watt prati varg metre prati kelvin ki chauthi ghat) banti hai. Iska maan lagbhag 5.67 x 10^-8 hota hai, isliye tapman daalte hi nikalne wali urja ka andaza ho jaata hai (jaise suraj se dharti par pahunchne wali urja). Is matrak se pata chalta hai ki tapman ka asar chauthi ghat ka hai tatha yield mein kelvin ka koi alag bhaag nahi. Isliye 'W/m2.K' ya 'J/kg' jaise vikalp is sthir gunank ke liye galat hote hain. Exam point: Stefan-Boltzmann constant ka SI matrak W/m2.K4 (watt per square metre per kelvin ki chauthi ghat) hota hai, aur iska maan 5.67 x 10^-8 hota hai.

qe: Why is 'Mercury' used in thermometers?
qh: थर्मामीटर में 'पारे' का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: High expansion coefficient | उच्च प्रसार गुणांक
Doesn't stick to glass | कांच से नहीं चिपकता
e: Paare (mercury) mein tapman ke saath bahut ek-sa failav hota hai isliye usse banaya gaya paimana saaf padha ja sakta hai; wo chamakdar aur opaak (dhundhla nahi) hota hai, kaanch se chipakta nahi aur ek bahut chauda tapman-parisar (lagbhag -39 degree C se 357 degree C) drav roop mein hi chalta rehta hai. Isi karan in sabhi gunon ka mila jod use thermometer ke liye sabse upyukt banata hai, isliye sahi jod 'ye sabhi' wala hai. Paani hota to wo failega bhi asamaanusar tatha 0-100 degree C ke bahar jam ya ubhal jaata. Isliye yak-ek gun pakadna galat hoga - sabhi gun saath kaam karte hain. Exam point: mercury thermometer mein paare ka istemal uske saaf failav, chamakdar roop, kaanch se chipakne na hone tatha chaude drav-tapman parisar ke karan hota hai (yani uperokt sabhi karan).

qe: What is 'Kinetic Energy' of a gas molecule at absolute zero?
qh: परम शून्य पर गैस के अणु की 'गतिज ऊर्जा' क्या होती है?
e: Isi tarah jab tapman nirapeksh shunya (0 K = -273.15 degree C) tak pahunchta hai to gas ke anuon ki sabhi chal-prakriya ruk jaati hai, isliye unki gati-urja (kinetic energy) shunya reh jaati hai (aadarsh gas ki kalpana ke hisaab se). Yehi karan hai ki 0 K ko 'gati ka thahrao' kaha jaata hai tatha theory mein gas ka dabav bhi shunya ho jaana chahiye. Vyavhar mein koi bhi vastavik padarth poore 0 K tak nahi pahunchta, isliye ye seema 'theoretical' maani jaati hai aur uske paas bhi kuchh quantum gati bachi rehti hai. Isliye yahan shunya wala jod hi sahi hai, koi nahi (negative) ya anant nahi. Exam point: nirapeksh shunya par gas ke anuon ki kinetic energy shunya maani jaati hai, kyunki wahan anuon ki chal-gati ruk jaati hai (ye ek aadarsh seema hai).

qe: Which gas is used for 'Low-temperature' gas thermometers?
qh: 'कम तापमान' वाले गैस थर्मामीटर के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग होता है?
e: Helium gas ka kvathank bahut kam (lagbhag 4.2 K) hota hai, isliye bahut kam tapman tak bhi wo gas avastha mein hi rehti hai tatha kisi temperature par jam nahi jaati (dabav bahut adhik na ho to). Isi karan aise gas-thermometer mein helium bhara jaata hai jo 1 K se lekin bahut kam tapman bhi maap leta hai. Iske saath hi helium rasiyanik roop se nishkriya tatha lagbhag aadarsh gas ki tarah byavhaar karti hai, isliye ganit ke hisaab mein bhi sahi baithti hai. Nitrogen ya oxygen itni kam tapman par drav-jam ho jaate hain isliye wahan kaam nahi karte. Exam point: bahut kam tapman maapne wale gas thermometer mein helium istemal hota hai, kyunki ye sabse nichle tapman tak bhi gas roop mein bani rehti hai.

qe: What is 'Latent Heat of Vaporization' for water (approx)?
qh: पानी के वाष्पीकरण की 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' (लगभग) कितनी है?
e: Paani ko bhaap mein badalne ke liye usi matara ki urja (lagbhag 540 calorie per gram = 2.26 x 10^6 J/kg) lagti hai jo uski gupat ushma kahlati hai; ye urja anuon ke beech ke poori tarah takraye bandhan todne tatha unhe svatantra karne mein kharch hoti hai, isliye tapman nahi badhta. Ise fusion ki gupat ushma (80 cal/g) se tulna karein to vapourization ki matara usse lagbhag satt guna adhik hoti hai, kyunki yahan bandhan poori tarah tootte hain. Isi karan bhaap se jalna paani ki uchchal se adhik gambhir hota hai. 334 kJ/kg wali matara fusion ki hai, isliye wo yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: paani ki vapourization gupat ushma lagbhag 540 cal/g (2.26 x 10^6 J/kg) hoti hai - ek baar ki poori urja jo bhaap banne mein kharch hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Regelation' observed in ice primarily due to?
qh: बर्फ में 'पुनर्हिमायन' मुख्य रूप से किसके कारण देखा जाता है?
e: Barf par dabav badhane se uska galaank ghat jaata hai, isliye barf dabav ke neeche pighal jaati hai - lekin jab dabav hatta hai to wo parat turant phir se jam jaati hai; isi kriya ko regelation kehte hain. Iske do karan saath kaam karte hain: (1) dabav se galaank ka girna tatha (2) aas-paas ki thandi barf tatha paani ke beech ushma ka turant bahav (jo pighli parat ko phir jama deta hai). Isi wajah se baarik taar ke bhaar tale barf kat kar bhi upar se phir jama rehti hai, aur skating ke pattay ke neeche chikni parat banti hai. Yadi keval tapman ya ghanatva ka kaam hota to ye kriya poori tarah samajh nahi aati. Exam point: regelation barf mein mukhya roop se dabav ke badlav ke karan dikhti hai - dabav se pighalna tatha dabav hatne par phir jama jaana.

qe: What is 'Coefficient of Linear Expansion' for Steel approximately?
qh: स्टील के लिए 'रैखीय प्रसार गुणांक' लगभग कितना है?
e: Steel ka lambai prasaar gunank lagbhag 1.2 x 10^-5 prati degree C hota hai - yani ek metre lambi chhadi ka tapman ek degree badhne par wo lagbhag 0.000012 metre (0.012 mm) lambi ho jaati hai. Chhoti lagne wali sankhya bhi bade dhanche par bahut asar dikhati hai - 100 metre ka pull 10 degree garam hone par lagbhag 12 mm lamba ho jaata hai. Isi karan steel ke pullon mein prasaar-joint (expansion joint) tatha patariyon ke beech antar chhoda jaata hai. Kaanch ya pital ki tulna mein steel ka maan kam hota hai, isliye bade dhaancho ke liye ye gun sahi jagah kaam ka hai. Exam point: steel ka linear expansion coefficient lagbhag 1.2 x 10^-5 per degree C hota hai - prati degree badlav par prati unit lambai mein hui chhoti badhotri.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of a monatomic gas at constant volume?
qh: स्थिर आयतन पर एक-परमाणुक गैस की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या है?
e: Monoatomic gas (jaise helium, neon) ke atom ka koi ghoornan (rotation) nahi hota, wo sirf aage-peeche, daaye-baaye tatha upar-neeche sthanantaran (translation) kar sakte hain - isliye suutra ke anusar Cv = (3/2) x R = 12.5 J/mol.K nikalta hai. Cp = Cv + R = (5/2)R hone se unka anupat gamma = 1.67 aata hai. Isi ganit se gasen saaf alag pehchaani ja sakti hain - dwiparmaanvik ke liye (5/2)R, bahuparmaanvik ke liye 3R ke lagbhag. Chunki ucch tapman par kampan (vibration) bhi jud jaate hain, isliye bahut adhik tapman par Cv ka maan 3R ki or badhta hai. Exam point: sthir aayatan par monoatomic gas ki molar ushma 3/2 R hoti hai; ye keval teen translation azaadi-dishaon se nikalta hai.

qe: Which process is 'Isentropic'?
qh: कौन सी प्रक्रिया 'आइसोएन्ट्रोपिक' (Isentropic) होती है?
e: Isentropic (sama-entropy) process wo hoti hai jismein kriya reversible tatha bina kisi ushma-vinimay (adiabatic) ke chalti hai, isliye usmein entropy ka badlav shunya rehta hai. Yadi kriya adiabatic to hai par gharsh ya seemit dabav-antar ke karan reversible nahi, to entropy badh jaati hai, isliye wo poori tarah isentropic nahi kahi ja sakti. Isi karan reversible adiabatic gas failav ka PV^gamma = sthir jaisa sambandh tatha entropy ki sthirata dono ek saath chalti hain. Isliye 'throttling' ya 'sthir-tapman' wale process isentropic nahi hote. Exam point: isentropic process reversible adiabatic hoti hai - ismein heat exchange nahi hota tatha entropy sthir rehta hai.

qe: What is 'Wien's Constant' approximately?
qh: 'वीन का नियतांक' लगभग कितना है?
e: Kisi bhi garam pind se nikalne wali vaikiran ka spektrum tatha uski adhiktam tezata ki tarangdairdhya uske tapman par nirbhar karti hai; Wien ke niyam ke anusar lambda_max x T = 0.29 cm.K (yani 2.9 x 10^-3 m.K) sthir rehta hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki tapman badhne par utsarg (emission ka rang) chhoti tarangdairdhya (neeche/nile rang) ki or khisak jaata hai - isliye uchch tapman par dhaatu ka rang pehle laal, phir peela tatha aage safed ho jaata hai. Isi niyam ke aadhaar par bhatti ke tapman ka pata lagane wala optical pyrometer bana hai. Bada ya rangeen vastu hone ka is niyam se judna galat hai, isliye anya jod sahi nahi. Exam point: Wien ka sthir gunank lagbhag 0.29 cm.K hota hai - tapman badhne par vaikiran abhiktam tarangdairdhya ghatti hai.

qe: What is 'Efficiency' of a Carnot engine with sink at absolute zero?
qh: परम शून्य सिंक वाले कार्नॉट इंजन की 'दक्षता' क्या होगी?
e: Carnot engine ka efficiency eta = 1 - T2/T1 hota hai, jahan T1 garam bhandar tatha T2 thande bhandar (sink) ka paramm tapman hai. Yadi sink ka tapman nirapeksh shunya ho (T2 = 0), to eta ka maan poora 1 (100%) aa jaata hai - yani poori heat kaam mein badal jaayegi. Ye keval ek aadarsh seema hai kyunki (a) 0 K tak pahunchana asambhav hai tatha (b) vyavhar mein gharsh tatha anya haaniyan bhi efficiency girati hain. Isi liye 100% wale vikalp ko theoretical seema samjhiye, sambhav vyavhar nahi. Exam point: sink ka tapman nirapeksh shunya ho to Carnot efficiency 100% hota hai, par ye keval ek aadarsh seema hai jo vyavhar mein nahi milti.

qe: Which color clothing is best for 'Winter'?
qh: 'सर्दियों' के लिए कौन से रंग के कपड़े सबसे अच्छे होते हैं?
e: Rang ka ushma ke saath rishta saada hai: kaali satah avashoshak (absorber) bhi sabse achhi tatha chhodne wali (emitter) bhi sabse achhi hoti hai, isliye siyaah (dark) kapde bahari vaikiran ki bahut adhik matara le dete hain aur shareer garam rakhte hain. Safed ya halke rang wali satah vaikiran ko bahut paravartit kar deti hai, isliye sardi mein wo utni sahayak nahi hoti. Isi karan sardi ki wajah se garam kapde bhi lene padte hain, sirf rang par nirbhar nahi raha jaata - par rang ke hissa se siyaah rang zyada sahayak hota hai. Exam point: sardi ke liye gahre/kaale (dark) kapde sabse upyukt hote hain, kyunki kaale rang vaikiran ke achhe avshoshak hote hain tatha shareer ko garam rakhte hain.

qe: What is 'Relative Humidity' of saturated air?
qh: संतृप्त हवा की 'सापेक्ष आर्द्रता' क्या होती है?
e: Santript (saturated) hawa ka matlab hai wo hawa jismein us tapman par jitni jal-vashp ruk sakti hai utni poori bhar chuki hai - aisi hawa mein koi aur vashp milkar bhi tik nahi paata tatha usi se baraf ya os (dew) banne lagti hai. Isi karan santript hawa ke liye nami ka anupat 100% hota hai, kyunki param bhau (capacity) tatha vartaman matara dono barabar hain. Yadi tapman girta hai to ye vashp sakht ho kar boondon mein badal jaata hai (isliye os, kuhasar tatha badal bante hain). Isliye 100% se alag aankde (jaise 50% ya 75%) asantript hawa ke liye hote hain. Exam point: santript hawa ki relative humidity 100% hoti hai - us tapman par usmein jal-vashp ki pooree bhau bhar chuki hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Thermodynamics' 1st Law a consequence of?
qh: ऊष्मागतिकी का प्रथम नियम किसका परिणाम है?
e: Thermodynamics ka pehla niyam yahi kehta hai ki urja na paida ki ja sakti hai na ki naast - wo keval ek roop se doosre roop mein badal sakti hai; isliye DQ = DU + DW ka roop mein likha jaata hai (di gayi ushma = andaruni urja mein badlav + bahari kaam). Ye dhaarna bhaautik ke vyaapak urja-sanrakshan niyam (conservation of energy) ka hi tharmonamics wala roop hai, isliye kisi bhi tantra mein kul urja sthir rehti hai. Isi karan pehla niyam 'sadiya' (perpetual motion of the first kind) ko sahaj hi kharij kar deta hai - bina urja diye kaam paana asambhav hai. Entropy ya tapman ke sambandh wale niyam isse alag hain. Exam point: ushmagatiki ka pehla niyam urja-sanrakshan (energy conservation) ka hi siddhant hai - urja sirf roop badalti hai, naast nahi hoti.

qe: What is 'Dew Point' related to?
qh: 'ओसांक' (Dew Point) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Hawa mein jal-vashp ki matara jab us tapman tak pahunchti hai jahan wo poori tarah santript ho jaati hai, usi tapman ko os-bindu (dew point) kehte hain - ye bindu us tapman ko batata hai jahan se neeche jaate hi jal-vashp chhoti boondon ke roop mein sakht (condense) hone lagta hai. Isi karan thandi raat mein ghaas-tinka patte par os tatha savere dhundh (fog) dikhti hai, aur garmi ke din AC ke pipe se paani tapakta hai. Ye 'vashpeekaran' ya 'usma-chaalakta' se juda nahi hai, kyunki bindu ka matlab hi jal ka drav roop mein badalna hai. Isi se kisaanon ko barish ka andaza bhi milta hai (bahut neeche dew point = barish ki sambhavna). Exam point: os-bindu (dew point) ka sambandh sanghanan (condensation) se hai - is tapman ke neeche aate hi hawa ka jal-vashp boondon mein badalne lagta hai.

qe: What happens to 'Thermal Conductivity' of metals with temp increase?
qh: तापमान बढ़ने पर धातुओं की 'तापीय चालकता' का क्या होता है?
e: Dhaatuon mein ushma ka bahav mukhya roop se mukta electron se hota hai; tapman badhne par jali (lattice) ke aayam tatha fano ke kampan tez hote hain, jo electron ke chalne ke raaste mein rukawat daalte hain - isliye dhaatuon ki ushma-chaalakta tapman badhne par ghat jaati hai. Iske ulat, ardh-chaalak (jaise germanium, silicon) ki chaalakta tapman badhne par badhti hai, kyunki wahan bahut se electron aavashyak urja paakar mukta ho jaate hain. Isi karan garam taave par garam tel tatha uchch tapman par dhaatu ke gun badal jaate hain. Isliye yahan 'ghat jaati hai' hi sahi jod hai, badhna ya sthir rehna nahi. Exam point: tapman badhne par dhaatuon ki thermal conductivity ghatti hai, kyunki kampan badhne se electron ke chalne mein rukawat badhti hai (ardh-chaalak mein ulta hota hai).

qe: What is 'Enthalpy' change at constant pressure equal to?
qh: स्थिर दाब पर 'एन्थैल्पी' में परिवर्तन किसके बराबर होता है?
o: Heat exchanged | विनिमय की गई ऊष्मा
e: Sthir dabav par kisi tantra ko di gai ushma seedha uske enthalpy ke badlav ke barabar hoti hai, isliye dQ = dH hota hai - yahi karan hai ki rasayanik kriyaon tatha bujhane-ubalne ki gannaa mein enthalpy ka istemal sabse zyada hota hai. Iska ganit ye hai ki H = U + PV hone se dH = dU + P.dV (sthir dabav par), jo pehle niyam ke dQ = dU + dW se mil jaata hai. Sthir aayatan wale tantra mein ushma seedha andaruni urja ka badlav hoti hai, isliye wahan ye sambandh nahi banta. Isliye 'usma-vinimay ki gai ushma' hi iska sahi jod hai. Exam point: sthir dabav par enthalpy ka badlav di gai ya li gayi ushma ke barabar hota hai (dH = dQ at constant pressure).

qe: What is 'Avogadro's Number' value?
qh: 'आवोगाद्रो संख्या' का मान क्या है?
e: Avogadro ki sankhya batati hai ki kisi bhi padarth ke ek mole mein lagbhag 6.022 x 10^23 kan (atom, anu ya aayan) hote hain - ye sankhya carbon-12 ke 12 gram mein maujood atomon ki sankhya se tay hoti hai. Isi se mol tatha gram ke beech ka pul banta hai, isliye rasayanik gannaa mein mass se kanon ki sankhya nikaalne ke liye yahi sankhya istemal hoti hai. Isi ke saath gas constant R = 8.314 J/mol.K tatha Boltzmann constant k = 1.38 x 10^-23 J/K ka sambandh R = Na x k ban jaata hai. Isliye 6.022 x 10^23 hi sahi aankda hai - 6.022 x 10^-23 ya 3.14 jaise man bilkul alag raashiyon ke hain. Exam point: Avogadro sankhya = 6.022 x 10^23 per mole hoti hai; ek mole padarth mein itne hi kan hote hain.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of Water in cal/g°C?
qh: cal/g°C में पानी की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या है?
e: Paani ki vishesh ushma lagbhag 1 calorie per gram per degree C hoti hai (yani 4.18 joule per gram per kelvin, ya 4186 J/kg.K) - iska matlab 1 gram paani ka tapman 1 degree C badhaane ke liye 1 calorie urja chahiye. Iska maan bahut padarthon se adhik hota hai, isliye paani ko garam hone tatha thanda hone mein zyada samay lagta hai - yahi gun mausam, jalvaayu tatha samudr tatha zameen ke tapman ko santulit rakhta hai. Isi karan garam paani ki bottle der tak garmi deti hai. Iski tulna mein dhaatuon ki vishesh ushma bahut kam (jaise loha 0.11 cal/g degree C) hoti hai, isliye wahan tapman jaldi badalta hai. Exam point: paani ki vishesh ushma 1 cal/g degree C (4.18 J/g.K) hoti hai - isliye paani ka tapman dheere-dheere badalta hai.

qe: What does an 'Adiabatic Wall' prevent?
qh: 'रुद्धोष्म दीवार' क्या रोकती है?
e: Adiabatic wall (bina heat diye dene wali deewar) do tantraon ke beech ushma ke bahav ko rok deti hai, isliye uske dono or ka tapman alag-alag reh sakta hai; iske ulat diathermic deewar ushma ko guzarne deti hai (jaise dhaatu ki patli deewar). Isi dhaarna ke aadhaar par tantra ko paribhashit kiya jaata hai - jo deewar ushma rok de, uske andar hone wale badlav 'adiabatic' maane jaate hain. Thermos flask ki do-diwari deewar tatha bhaap ke pipe ki insulation isi siddhant par kaam karti hai. Isliye ye aayatan ya dravyaman ko nahi rokti, keval ushma ke bahav ko rok deti hai. Exam point: adiabatic wall ushma ke bahav (heat flow) ko rokti hai - isliye ise paar karne wale tantra ke liye dQ = 0 ho jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Carnot Cycle' an idealization of?
qh: 'कार्नॉट चक्र' किसका एक आदर्शीकरण है?
e: Carnot chakra do sthir tapmanon ke beech chalne wale kisi bhi ushma-engine ka aadarsh (ideal) roop hai - ismein 4 kriyaein: sthir tapman par failav (isothermal), bina heat ke failav (adiabatic), sthir tapman par sankochan tatha bina heat ke sankochan milti hain. Iska koi gharsh (friction) ya seemit (sudden) kriya nahi hoti, isliye iska efficiency sabse adhik hota hai tatha kisi bhi vastavik engine ka efficiency isse adhik nahi ho sakta - isi liye ye kisi bhi engine ki seema batane ke liye aadarsh roop hai. Isliye ye refrigerator ya heat pump ka aadarsh roop nahi balki ushma-engines ka aadarsh roop hai. Iske aadhaar par doosre law ka ganit bhi banta hai. Exam point: Carnot chakra heat engine ka aadarsh (ideal) roop hai - kisi bhi engine ki adhiktam sambhav efficiency isi se tay hoti hai.

qe: What happens to 'Relative Humidity' when temperature increases (at constant moisture)?
qh: (स्थिर नमी पर) तापमान बढ़ने पर 'सापेक्ष आर्द्रता' का क्या होता है?
e: Vayu mein jitna jal-vashp ho sakta hai wo tapman ke saath badalta hai; tapman badhne par hawa ki vashp-rokne ki kshamata (capacity) badh jaati hai, isliye usi naami ke liye relative humidity ghat jaati hai. Isi liye dopahar mein hawa zyada garam hone se nami kam lagti hai, jabki subah-thandi raat mein wahi hawa lagbhag santript ho jaati hai tatha os ya kuhasar dikhti hai. Yadi tapman girta hai to tam pani nahi badalta par bhau ghatne se anupat badh jaata hai (der-100% ki or badhta hai). Isliye 'badhti hai' ya 'same rehti hai' wale kathan yahan galat hain. Exam point: naami ka sthir rehte hue tapman badhne par relative humidity ghatti hai, kyunki garam hawa mein vashp-rokne ki kshamata badh jaati hai.

qe: What is the relation between Root Mean Square speed ($v_{rms}$) and Temperature (T)?
qh: वर्ग माध्य मूल चाल ($v_{rms}$) और तापमान (T) के बीच क्या संबंध है?
e: Aadarsh gas ke anuon ki gati-urja tapman ke samanupati hoti hai, aur unki ausat varg (square) gati se RMS speed banti hai; isliye v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M) ke anusar v_rms tapman ki varg-mool (square root) ke samanupati hota hai. Iska matlab tapman chaar guna karne par speed keval dugni hoti hai, chaar guna nahi. Isi sambandh se pata chalta hai ki halki gas (helium) ki anuon ki speed bhari gas (oxygen) se adhik hoti hai tatha dhvani ki speed bhi isi se judi hoti hai. Isliye 'T' ya 'T^2' wale jod asamaanupat hain. Exam point: v_rms tapman ke varg-mool ke samanupati hota hai (v_rms lagbhag sqrt(T)); ye Maxwell-Boltzmann vitaran se nikalta hai.

qe: Which molecular speed is the 'Highest' among these for a gas?
qh: गैस के लिए इनमें से कौन सी आणविक चाल 'सबसे अधिक' होती है?
o: RMS speed | वर्ग माध्य मूल चाल (RMS speed)
e: Gas ke anuon ki gati Maxwell-Boltzmann vitaran ke anusar faili hoti hai, jismein teen ausat gatiyan prachlit hain: sabse adhik sambhavit (most probable) sabse kam, ausat (mean) usse thoda adhik, tatha varg-mool-usat (RMS) sabse adhik hoti hai (v_rms > v_mean > v_mp, anupat lagbhag 1.73 : 1.60 : 1.41). Isliye RMS speed hamesha sabse adhik hoti hai, kyunki ismein gatiyon ka varg (square) liya jaata hai, isse tez anuon ka bhaar zyada lagta hai. Inhi teen gatiyon se diffusion, viscosity tatha ushma-chaalakta jaise gun samjhaaye jaate hain. Exam point: in teen gatiyon mein RMS speed (varg madhya mool chaal) sabse adhik hoti hai, kyunki ismein gati ke varg ka ausat liya jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Thermal Stress' developed in a rod prevented from expanding?
qh: प्रसार से रोकी गई छड़ में उत्पन्न 'तापीय प्रतिबल' (Thermal Stress) क्या है?
e: Jab kisi chhadi ko garam hone se failne nahi diya jaata (dono sire jakad diye jaate hain), to failure rokne wala aantarik bal presh (stress) paida karta hai, jise tharmal stress kehte hain; iska maan Y x alpha x Delta T hota hai (Y Young's modulus, alpha lambai prasaar gunank, Delta T tapman-antar). Lambe pull, patari tatha pipe aise hi stress se tute ya mud sakte hain, isliye unmein prasaar-joint chhod jaate hain. Yadi sirf ek sira jakda ho to bhi bal lagta hai par stress kam hota hai, isliye kuchh antar aata hai - par sutra wahi rehta hai. Isliye Y x alpha x Delta T wali form hi sahi hai, anya jod galat. Exam point: rok lagaane par bana thermal stress = Y x alpha x Delta T hota hai; ye tapman-antar, padarth ki kamani tatha prasaar gunank teeno par nirbhar karta hai.

qe: Why are gaps left between 'Railway Rails'?
qh: 'रेलवे की पटरियों' के बीच खाली जगह क्यों छोड़ी जाती है?
o: To allow for thermal expansion | तापीय प्रसार के लिए जगह देने हेतु
e: Patariyon (railway rails) ke beech thoda antar chhodne ka karan yahi hai ki dhoop mein garam hone par loha failta hai - yadi koi jagah na ho to ye prasaar bahut bada presh (stress) banata hai jo mel (weld) ya joint tod sakta hai tatha patari tedhi ho sakti hai. Isliye barf-dhoop mein failne ki jagah dene ke liye antar chhoda jaata hai, jise expansion joint kehte hain. Isi tarah pullon par patti (roller) tatha jhulay wale joint bhi isi kaaran bante hain. Yadi tapman girega to patari sikudi hai aur wo antar kam ho jaata hai, isliye ye antar itna rakha jaata hai ki dono seemaon par kaam kare. Exam point: patariyon ke beech antar thermal expansion ke liye jagah dene ke liye chhoda jaata hai, taaki garam hone par loha failne se patari tute nahi.

qe: What is the 'Mean Free Path' of a gas molecule inversely proportional to?
qh: गैस के अणु का 'माध्य मुक्त पथ' किसके व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है?
e: Gas ke anuon ki ausat doori tatha sankhya-ghanatva (number density) se unka mean free path tay hota hai; sutra lambda = 1/(sqrt(2) x n x pi x d^2) ke anusar ye ghanatva (tatha dabav) ke vyutkram (inverse) anupat mein hota hai - ghanatva dugna karne par free path adha reh jaata hai. Iska karan saaf hai: anu paas-paas honge to takraav jaldi-jaldi honge. Tapman badhne par anuon ke aakaar se free path ka seedha sambandh nahi hota (wo ghanatva se tay hota hai), isliye ye bhi dhyan mein rakhein. Isi liye vacuum mein mean free path bahut bada ho jaata hai, jo katod-kiran nali jaise prayog mein kaam aata hai. Exam point: mean free path ghanatva ke vyutkram anupat mein hota hai (ghana anuon ke beech takraav jaldi hone se path chhota ho jaata hai).

qe: What is 'Solar Energy' primarily produced by?
qh: 'सौर ऊर्जा' मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा उत्पन्न होती है?
e: Suraj ki urja ka mool srot nabhiyaa sanlagna (nuclear fusion) hai - wahaan hydrogen ke nabhik mil kar helium banate hain tatha is kriya mein chhota bhaar-antar urja (E = mc^2) ke roop mein nikalta hai. Isi urja se suraj ka tapman tatha chamak bani rehti hai; dwitiy taur par gamit tatha bhaari tatvon ka nirmaran bhi isi ke baad hota hai. Fission (nabhik vishleshan) tatha jalne ki rasiyanik kriya se ye alag hain - fission mein bhaari nabhik tootate hain tatha rasiyanik kriya mein keval electron ka sthanantaran hota hai. Isliye suraj ke liye sanlagna hi sahi jawab hai, anya vikalp nahi. Exam point: suraj ki urja nuclear fusion (nabhiyaa sanlagna) se banti hai - hydrogen ke nabhik milakar helium banate hain tatha urja bahar aati hai.

qe: In which process is the 'Work Done' maximum for the same expansion?
qh: समान प्रसार के लिए किस प्रक्रिया में 'किया गया कार्य' अधिकतम होता है?
e: Jab kisi gas ko failne diya jaata hai, to kiya gaya kaam failav ke samay ke ausat dabav par nirbhar karta hai; isobaric (sthir dabav) process mein gas poore dabav par failta hai, isliye ismein sabse zyada kaam (W = P x Delta V) milta hai. Adiabatic failav mein gas thandi tatha dabavi girta hai, isliye kaam kam hota hai (isothermal se bhi kam ya zyada ho sakta hai, par isobaric se kam). Isi karan vistarit (expansion) se kaam nikaalne ke liye garam kar ke dabav barqarar rakhna sabse faydemand hota hai, jaise bhaap engine mein. Isliye 'isobaric' hi sabse adhik kaam deta hai. Exam point: ek hi failav ke liye sabse adhik kaam isobaric process mein hota hai, kyunki wahan dabav sthir rehta hai aur W = P x Delta V banta hai.

qe: What is 'Emissive Power' unit?
qh: 'उत्सर्जन क्षमता' (Emissive Power) का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Kisi satah ki emissive power batati hai ki wo prati second prati varg metre kitni ushma-vaikiran chhodti hai, isliye iski SI ikai W/m2 (watt prati varg metre) banti hai - yani ye vaikiran ki tezata ka maap hai. Stefan-Boltzmann ke anusar achhe utsargak ke liye ye maan sigma x T^4 hota hai, isliye tapman ke saath tezi se badhta hai. Iska sambandh kelvin (tapman ke matrak) ya pascal (dabav ke matrak) se nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan galat hain. Isi gun se bijli ke bulb tatha bhatti ke tapman ka andaza lagaya jaata hai. Exam point: emissive power ki ikai W/m2 hoti hai - ye prati unit kshetrafal prati second chhodi gayi ushma-vaikiran ka maap hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Viscosity' of liquids with increase in 'Temperature'?
qh: 'तापमान' बढ़ने पर द्रवों की 'श्यानता' (Viscosity) का क्या होता है?
e: Dravon ki shyaanata (viscosity) tapman badhne par ghatti jaati hai - kyunki garam hone par anuon ke beech ka aakarshan bal kam ho jaata hai tatha part (layer) aasaani se ek doosre par sarak jaati hain (isliye garam tel patla ho jaata hai tatha engine garam hone par theek se chalne lagta hai). Iske ulat, gases mein tapman badhne par shyaanata badhti hai kyunki wahan asar gati (momentum) ke aadan-pradan se hota hai tatha anu tez chalne lagte hain. Isi farq ke karan gas tatha drav ke liye tapman ka asar ulta hota hai - ise yad rakhein. Isliye drav ke liye badhne wale ya apariwartit rehne wale jod sateek nahi baithte. Exam point: drav ki shyaanata tapman badhne par ghatti hai (aakarshan bal kam hone se), jabki gases mein ulta badhti hai.

qe: What is 'Joule-Thomson' expansion also known as?
qh: 'जूल-थॉमसन' प्रसार को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Joule-Thomson failav ko hi vyavhar mein 'throttling process' kehte hain - ismein gas ek patli chhidra (valve, pinhole) se guzarti hai, isliye uska dabav girta hai tatha enthalpy sthir rehti hai (kaam bhi utna hi hota hai jitni aantarik urja ka parivartan). Isi kriya se aam gasen thandi hoti hain, isliye refrigerator tatha pashchim-vaayu se drav banane wale plants mein yahi dhaarna kaam aati hai. Ismein gas ko bahari kaam nahi diya jaata tatha na hi usse kaam nikala jaata hai, isliye ye 'free expansion' se alag hai. Throttling hi iska doosra naam hai - koi anay naam nahi. Exam point: Joule-Thomson failav ko throttling process bhi kehte hain - ismein patli chhidra se gas guzar kar thandi ya garam hoti hai.

qe: Which substance has 'Negative' coefficient of thermal expansion near 0°C to 4°C?
qh: 0°C से 4°C के बीच किस पदार्थ का तापीय प्रसार गुणांक 'ऋणात्मक' होता है?
e: Saadharan taur par tapman badhne par sabhi padarth failte hain, par paani 0 degree C se 4 degree C ke beech ulta byavhaar karta hai - is seema mein tapman badhne par uska aayatan ghatta hai tatha ghanatva badhta hai, isliye us gunank ka maan rin (negative) hota hai. Iska karan yahi ki 4 degree C ke aas-paas paani mein hydrogen bandhan ki dhancha sabse ghan (compact) banti hai tatha 0 degree C ke paas khuli dhancha (khaali jagah) ban jaati hai. Isi ajeeb gun ke karan paani ka ghanatva 4 degree C par adhiktam hota hai tatha barf paani par tairti hai - jeevon ke liye ye vardaan hai. Exam point: 0 degree C se 4 degree C ke beech paani ka prasaar gunank rin (negative) hota hai, kyunki is seema mein tapman badhne par paani sikudta hai.

qe: What is 'Radiation Pressure' exerted by sunlight on Earth approximately?
qh: पृथ्वी पर सूर्य के प्रकाश द्वारा डाला गया 'विकिरण दाब' लगभग कितना है?
e: Surya ki kiranon mein bhi samveg (momentum) hota hai, isliye jab wo kisi satah se takrati ya sokhi jaati hai to halka-sa dabav daalti hai; ise radiation pressure kehte hain. Dharti par saadharan vatavaran ke bahar surya ki tezata lagbhag 1360 W/m2 hone se ye dabav kuchh micro-pascal ke kram ka hota hai (lagbhag 10^-6 Pa) - bada nahi, par dhoomketu ki poonch tatha solar sail jaise anuprayogon ke liye mahatvapurn hai. Bahari vayumandal mein ye dabav bahut chhota hai, isliye 1 Pa ya 1 atm jaise man yahan bilkul galat hain. Isi dabav se vaigyanik aasu-aasu vaayu se bahar bhi urja-nau chalaane ke prayog karte hain. Exam point: surya ki kiranon ka radiation pressure dharti par lagbhag 10^-6 pascal ke kram ka hota hai - ye bahut chhota par mahatvapurn asar hai.

qe: Which law states that 'Total Energy = Internal Energy + Work Done'?
qh: कौन सा नियम कहता है कि 'कुल ऊर्जा = आंतरिक ऊर्जा + किया गया कार्य'?
o: First Law of Thermodynamics | ऊष्मागतिकी का प्रथम नियम
e: Ushmagatiki ka pehla niyam urja-sanrakshan ka kathan hai: dQ = dU + dW, yani di gayi ushma (dQ) tantra ki andaruni urja (dU) tatha kiye gaye kaam (dW) ke jod ke barabar hoti hai - isi tarah 'kul urja = andaruni urja + kaam' wala roop banta hai. Iska arth ye hai ki tantra ko ushma diye bina usse kaam nahi nikaala ja sakta, tatha ushma diye bina urja badhai nahi ja sakti. Isi niyam se sadiya (perpetual motion) ki pehli kalpana kharij ho jaati hai tatha rashiyan sahi baithti hain. Isliye is kathan ka sambandh doosre (entropy) ya teesre (0 K) niyam se nahi hai. Exam point: 'kul urja = andaruni urja + kaam' wala sambandh ushmagatiki ke pehle niyam (First Law) ka hi roop hai, jo urja-sanrakshan par tika hai.

qe: What is 'Efficiency' of a Diesel cycle compared to Otto for same 'Peak Pressure'?
qh: समान 'शिखर दाब' के लिए डीजल चक्र की 'दक्षता' ऑटो की तुलना में क्या होती है?
e: Same peak (adhiktam) dabav tatha same di gai ushma par jab Diesel tatha Otto chakra ki tulna karte hain, to Diesel ka efficiency adhik nikalta hai; iska karan yahi hai ki Diesel chakra mein ushma sthir dabav par di jaati hai (isobaric), isliye utni hi adhiktam ushma me zyada kaam nikalta hai. Iske ulat, isko dhyaan mein rakhein ki same compression ratio par Otto ka efficiency adhik hota hai - matlab tulna ka aadhaar badla ki jawab palat jaata hai. Vyavhar mein Diesel engine apni adhik compression ratio ke karan hi zyada kushal hota hai. Isliye 'same peak pressure' wali tulna mein 'higher' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: same peak pressure par Diesel chakra ki efficiency Otto se adhik hoti hai, kyunki Diesel mein ushma sthir dabav (isobaric) par milti hai.

qe: What is 'Ice Point' in Fahrenheit?
qh: फारेनहाइट में 'बर्फ का बिंदु' (Ice Point) क्या है?
e: Saadharan dabav (1 atm) par barf pighalne ka tapman 0 degree C hota hai, aur Fahrenheit paimane par yahi bindu 32 degree F par aata hai; isliye paani ka 'ice point' 32 degree F kaha jaata hai. Fahrenheit tatha Celsius ke beech ka sambandh F = (9/5)C + 32 hota hai, isliye C = 0 rakhte hi F = 32 aa jaata hai. Kai purane American tatha British thermometer aaj bhi isi paimane par chalte hain, isliye mausam ki khabron mein 32, 212 jaise aankde dikhte hain. Isliye 0 degree F ya 100 degree F jaise jod yahan galat hote hain (100 degree F to lagbhag 37.8 degree C hota hai). Exam point: barf ka pighalne ka bindu Fahrenheit paimane par 32 degree F hota hai (jabki Celsius par 0 degree C).

qe: What is 'Steam Point' in Fahrenheit?
qh: फारेनहाइट में 'भाप का बिंदु' (Steam Point) क्या है?
e: Ek vayumandaliya dabav par paani ka kvathank (boiling point) 100 degree C hota hai; Celsius se Fahrenheit banane ka sutra F = (9/5)C + 32 hai, isliye C = 100 rakhne par 180 + 32 = 212 mil jaata hai. Isliye Celsius par paani ka tapman-ghera 0 se 100 degree C tak faela hota hai jabki Fahrenheit par yahi ghera 32 se 212 degree F ban jaata hai, yani Fahrenheit mein 180 hisse. Isliye 100 degree F ya 180 degree F wale jod yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: saadharan dabav par paani ka kvathank Fahrenheit paimane par 212 degree F hota hai (Celsius par 100 degree C).

qe: What is 'Absolute Scale' of temperature also called?
qh: तापमान के 'परम पैमाने' को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Kisi bhi tapman-paimane ka sabse nichla bindu uske padarth par nirbhar karta hai; Kelvin paimana nirapeksh shunya (0 K = -273.15 degree C) se shuru hota hai aur ismein koi rin (negative) aankda nahi aata, isliye ise 'paramm paimana' ya absolute scale kehte hain. Iska ek degree Celsius ke ek degree ke barabar hi hota hai, keval shuruaat ka bindu alag hota hai - isliye K = C + 273.15 ka sambandh banta hai. Isi karan vaigyanik ganna tatha ushmagatiki ke saare sutra (jaise PV = nRT) mein tapman kelvin mein hi liya jaata hai. Isliye 'Celsius' ya 'Fahrenheit' ko absolute scale nahi kaha ja sakta, kyunki unmein rin aankde aate hain. Exam point: absolute scale ko Kelvin scale kehte hain - ye nirapeksh shunya se shuru hota hai tatha ismein rin tapman nahi hota.

qe: Which physical quantity is constant in 'Charles's Law'?
qh: 'चार्ल्स के नियम' में कौन सी भौतिक राशि स्थिर रहती है?
e: Charles ke niyam ke anusar kisi gas ka aayatan uske paramm tapman ke samanupati hota hai jab dabav ek hi jaisa bana rahe - isliye is niyam mein dabav ko na badalne ki shart hoti hai, aur use 'constant pressure law' ya 'isobaric law' bhi kehte hain. Iska roop V/T = sthir hota hai, isliye tapman badhne par aayatan badhta hai (jaise garam hawa se gubbara phoolta hai tatha uchch tapman par garm hawa ka aayatan badh jaata hai). Boyle ke niyam mein tapman sthir hota hai tatha dabav-aayatan ka sambandh hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Charles ke niyam mein dabav ek hi jaisa bana rehta hai - aayatan paramm tapman ke saath samanupati badhta hai (V/T = sthir).

qe: What is 'Thermal Diffusivity' unit?
qh: 'तापीय विसरणशीलता' का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Thermal diffusivity batati hai ki koi padarth kitni tezi se tapman ke badlav ko apne andar aage le jaata hai; iska sutra alpha = k/(rho x c) hone se iski ikai square metre per second (m2/s) banti hai, kyunki upar W/m.K tatha niche ghantva x vishesh ushma aata hai. Iska arth yahi hai ki jis padarth ki diffusivity adhik hogi, uska tapman tezi se badlega - isliye mausam tatha bhavan ke dhaanche ke hisaab mein ye gun bahut kaam aata hai. Isse tapman badalne ka samay tatha garam hone ki gahrai nikaali jaati hai. Isliye kg/m3 ya J/kg.K jaise matrak iske nahi hain (wo ghantva tatha vishesh ushma ke hain). Exam point: thermal diffusivity ki ikai m2/s hoti hai; ye batati hai ki padarth mein tapman ka badlav kitni tezi se failta hai.

qe: What is 'Clausius Statement' related to?
qh: 'क्लॉसियस कथन' किससे संबंधित है?
o: Refrigerator / Heat Pump | रेफ्रिजरेटर / हीट पंप
e: Clausius kathan ushma-ke-doosre-niyam ka wo roop hai jo refrigerator tatha heat pump se juda hai - yani bahari kaam (W) ke bina ushma ko thande pind se garam pind tak bhejna sambhav nahi. Isliye ghar ka refrigerator bijli ke bina thanda nahi ho sakta, tatha ushe chhodi gayi ushma (Q1) tatha kharch kiye gaye kaam (W) ka jod garam jagah ko jaata hai. Iske ulat Kelvin-Planck kathan heat engine se juda hai (jahan ek hi srot se poori urja lekar poora kaam nikaalna asambhav maana jaata hai). Isliye is prashn mein refrigerator tatha heat pump hi sahi jod hain. Exam point: Clausius kathan refrigerator tatha heat pump se sambandhit hai - bina kaam ke ushma ka bahav thande se garam ki or sambhav nahi.

qe: What is 'Entropy' change for an irreversible process in an isolated system?
qh: एक विलगित निकाय में अनुत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रिया के लिए 'एन्ट्रॉपी' परिवर्तन क्या होता है?
e: Asantulit (irreversible) kriya mein tantra ke andar vikhepank badhta hai, isliye izolited (isolated - bahari sanyog se alag) tantra mein aisi kriyaon se entropy ka badlav sada dhan (positive) hota hai. Yadi kriya utkramniya (reversible) ho to upyogi badlav shunya hota hai; dhan ya rin saman matara ka koi bhi vastavik jod is seema ko todta hai. Yahi 'entropy kabhi ghatti nahi' wala kathan aage badhkar samay ki disha tatha ushma-ki-mrityu (heat death) ki dhaarna deta hai. Isliye 'shuny' wala jod utkramniya kriya ka hota hai, asantulit kriya ka nahi. Exam point: izolited tantra mein asantulit kriya ke liye entropy ka badlav sada dhan (positive) hota hai - ye doosre niyam ka mool kathan hai.

qe: Which state of matter is the 'Worst' conductor of heat?
qh: पदार्थ की कौन सी अवस्था ऊष्मा की 'सबसे खराब' चालक है?
e: Ushma-chaalakta ke liye kanon ka paas-paas hona zaroori hai; gases mein kan ek doosre se bahut door rehte hain tatha unke beech takraav kam hote hain, isliye gas ko teeno avasthaon mein sabse khrabz ushma-chaalak kaha jaata hai. Isi karan havva tatha CO2 jaise gases ko deewaron tatha khidkiyon ke andar band kar ke insulation ka kaam liya jaata hai (double-pane glass, thermos flask). Thos mein kan kas kar baithe hote hain tatha dhaatuon mein mukta electron bhi garmi le jaate hain, isliye wahan chaalakta sabse adhik hoti hai. Isliye 'gas' hi sahi jod hai, thos ya drav nahi. Exam point: gases ushma ki sabse khrabz chaalak hoti hain, kyunki unke kan door-door tatha kam takraav wale hote hain.

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of a gas in an isothermal process?
qh: समतापी प्रक्रिया में गैस की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या होती है?
e: Isothermal process mein tapman ko sthir rakha jaata hai; yadi aise process mein gas ko heat di jaaye to wo tapman badhne ke bajaye aayatan badhane tatha kaam karne mein kharch ho jaati hai - isliye tapman mein koi badlav dikhe bina hi badi heat li ja sakti hai. Sutra c = dQ/(m x dT) mein dT shunya ho jaata hai jabki dQ shunya nahi, isliye vishesh ushma ka maan anant (infinite) nikalta hai. Iska koi arth ye nahi ki gas heat nahi leti; wo heat leti hai par tapman nahi badalta. Iske ulat adiabatic process mein dQ shunya hota hai, isliye wahan ye maan shunya nikalta hai - dono ko yaad rakhein. Exam point: isothermal process mein gas ki vishesh ushma anant hoti hai, kyunki heat dene par bhi tapman sthir rehta hai (dT = 0).

qe: What is 'Specific Heat' of a gas in an adiabatic process?
qh: रुद्धोष्म प्रक्रिया में गैस की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' क्या होती है?
e: Adiabatic process mein dQ shunya hota hai (na heat di jaati hai na li jaati hai), isliye c = dQ/(m x dT) kaans se vishesh ushma ka maan shunya nikalta hai - gas garam ya thandi ho sakti hai par uske badlav ke liye heat leti nahi. Temperature ka badlav yahan kaam ke karan hota hai: sampeedan (compression) mein gas garam tatha failav mein thandi hoti hai (isi karan cycle pump tatha diesel engine ka siddhant bana). Iske ulat isothermal process mein ye maan anant hota hai - dono vikalp alag-alag process ke hain, isliye inhe milaayein nahi. Exam point: adiabatic process mein gas ki vishesh ushma shunya hoti hai, kyunki usmein heat ka koi aadan-pradan hi nahi hota (dQ = 0).

qe: What is the 'Gas Constant' (R) value in SI units?
qh: SI मात्रक में 'गैस नियतांक' (R) का मान क्या है?
e: Gas constant R ka maan 8.314 J/mol.K hota hai - ye ek mole gas ke liye prati kelvin tapman par kiye gaye vistar ke kaam ka maap hai tatha aadarsh gas ke samikaran PV = nRT mein aata hai. Isi R se Mayer ka sambandh Cp - Cv = R banta hai tatha vishesh ushmaon tatha molar ushmaon ke beech ka anupat tay hota hai. Iska maan aankdon mein 0.0821 litre-atm/mol.K bhi likha jaata hai jab matrak badalta hai (dabav litre tatha atm mein ho) - isliye matrak dekhna zaroori hai. Isliye 8.314 hi SI roop hai, 1.987 cal/mol.K anya matrak hai tatha 6.022 x 10^23 Avogadro sankhya hai. Exam point: gas constant R = 8.314 J/mol.K hota hai; aankda badalne par matrak tatha padarth badalne se alag roop likhe jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Sublimation' process used for in food industry?
qh: खाद्य उद्योग में 'ऊर्ध्वपातन' प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
e: Sublimation ka matlab hai thos padarth ka seedha bhaap mein badalna (drav avastha mein aaye bina) - isi gun ka fayda uthakar 'freeze drying' ki jaati hai. Ismein geele padarth ko pehle jamaya jaata hai tatha phir dabav kam karke barf ko seedha bhaap banne diya jaata hai, isse padarth ki dhaancha, sugandh tatha poshak tatva (vitamins) bache rehte hain. Isi karan coffee, dudh ka powder, masale tatha tibbi vaccines sudhaarte hain - aam sukhane se ye gun nasht ho jaate hain. Isliye 'freeze drying' hi sahi jod hai, ubhana ya bhaap-sankochan iska kaam nahi. Exam point: sublimation ka istemal khadyon ko freeze drying (jamakar sukhane) ke liye hota hai - barf seedha bhaap banti hai, drav nahi.

qe: What is 'Stefan's Law' for a non-black body?
qh: एक गैर-कृष्ण पिंड के लिए 'स्टीफन का नियम' क्या है?
e: Stefan ke niyam ka aadhaar-patra roop E = sigma x T^4 sirf pooray kaale pind (black body) ke liye hai; vastavik satah poori vaikiran sokhti nahi, isliye uske liye ek uchhvasata gunank (emissivity, epsilon) lagta hai tatha sutra E = epsilon x sigma x T^4 ban jaata hai. Saadharan satah ka epsilon 0 se 1 ke beech hota hai (chamakdar satah ka bahut kam, mat dhaatu ka lagbhag 0.9), isliye us se nikalne wali urja kaali satah se hamesha kam hoti hai. Isi karan kaali satah ka vaikiran utsarg sabse adhik lagta hai tatha ushe 'aadarsh utsargak' maana jaata hai. Exam point: kaale pind ke alaava kisi bhi satah ke liye Stefan ka niyam E = epsilon x sigma x T^4 hota hai, jahan epsilon uski uchhvasata (emissivity) batata hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Speed of Sound' in air with increase in 'Temperature'?
qh: 'तापमान' बढ़ने पर हवा में 'ध्वनि की चाल' का क्या होता है?
e: Kisi gas ke vatavaran mein dhvani ki speed dadh tatha kanon ke salaam ki urja par tikti hai; tapman badhne par kan tez chalte hain isliye tapman ke saath speed badhti hai (lagbhag v = 331 + 0.61 x T m/s). Isi karan garmi ke din dhvani jaldi sunai deti hai tatha uchch tapman wali gas mein sound ki speed adhik hoti hai. Ghanatva badhne par ya kam tapman par speed ghatti hai - isliye uchch sthalon par (jahan tapman kam) sound dheere chalti hai, jabki jal mein speed hawa se adhik hoti hai. Isliye tapman badhne par 'badhti hai' hi sahi jod hai, ghatna ya sthir rehna nahi. Exam point: hawa mein dhvani ki speed tapman badhne par badhti hai (kanon ki tez chal ke kaaran), lagbhag 0.61 metre/second prati degree C.

qe: Which law explains why 'Hot air rises'?
qh: कौन सा नियम बताता है कि 'गर्म हवा ऊपर क्यों उठती है'?
o: Charles's Law | चार्ल्स का नियम (via density)
e: Garam hawa halki (kam ghantva) hoti hai aur thandi hawa bhari; isi ghanatva ke antar se garam hawa upar uthti hai tatha thandi hawa niche aati hai - yehi chakra 'hot air rises' ka asli karan hai. Iss kriya ka ganit Charles ke niyam se juda hai, kyunki sthir dabav par tapman badhne se aayatan badhta hai (yani ghantva ghatta hai) tatha hawa apni jagah se upar uth jaati hai. Isi gun se samudra-tat par samvahan (breeze), chhimni (chimney) ka dhuan tatha garm gubbare ka uthna samjha jaata hai. Isliye 'Charles ka niyam (density ke zariye)' hi sahi jod hai, kyunki hot air rises ka mool aadhaar sthir dabav par failav tatha ghantva ka badlav hai. Exam point: garam hawa ke upar uthne ka karan Charles ka niyam (sthir dabav par failav) se juda ghanatva ka farq hai.

qe: What is 'Critical Temperature' of CO2?
qh: CO2 का 'क्रांतिक तापमान' क्या है?
e: Carbon dioxide ki critical temperature lagbhag 31.1 degree C (304 K) hoti hai - is tapman se upar ushe kitna bhi dabav laga kar drav nahi kiya ja sakta, chahe 100 atm se bhi zyada dabav dein. Isi karan CO2 ko drav karke cylinder mein bharne ke liye pehle ushe 31.1 degree C se niche thanda karna padta hai, phir dabav dekar drav banaya jaata hai; drav CO2 ko soda, aag-bujhaane wale yantra tatha supercritical extraction mein istemal karte hain. Paani ki critical temperature 374 degree C tatha oxygen ki -118 degree C hoti hai, isliye wo aankde CO2 ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: CO2 ki critical temperature 31.1 degree C (304 K) hoti hai - is seema ke paar jaane par dabav kitna bhi badhaya jaaye, CO2 drav nahi banti.

qe: Which instrument is used to measure 'Relative Humidity'?
qh: 'सापेक्ष आर्द्रता' मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग होता है?
e: Relative humidity batati hai ki hawa mein us tapman par urokit jitna jal-vashp aa sakta hai (saturation) uske kitne pratishat bhare hue hain; ise maapne wala yantra hygrometer kehlata hai. Ismein aksar baal (hair) ki lambai ka badlav tatha do thermometer (wet-bulb tatha dry-bulb) ka farq kaam aata hai - bhaap ka asar tatha tapman ke antar se nami ka andaza hota hai. Isi yantra se mausam-vigyan tatha anaj ke godown mein nami ki nigrani hoti hai, kyunki adhik nami se fasal sad jaati hai. Thermometer keval tapman batata hai, bolometer vaikiran tatha pyrometer uchch tapman maapta hai - isliye ye vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: relative humidity maapne ka yantra hygrometer hota hai (wet-bulb tatha dry-bulb thermometer ke antar se khoya nami ka pata chalta hai).

qe: What is 'Specific Latent Heat' of steam compared to ice?
qh: बर्फ की तुलना में भाप की 'विशिष्ट गुप्त ऊष्मा' क्या है?
o: Much Higher | बहुत अधिक (540 vs 80 cal/g)
e: Kisi padarth ko avastha badalne ke liye lagne wali urja uske bandhanon ki majbooti par tikti hai; bhaap banane ke liye anuon ke beech ke saare aakarshan bandhan todne padte hain, jabki pighalne mein keval jali dheeli hoti hai - isliye bhaap ki gupat ushma (540 cal/g) barf ki gupat ushma (80 cal/g) se lagbhag satt guna adhik hoti hai. Issi wajah se bhaap ki chot paani ki uchchal se kashtdayak hoti hai tatha paseena bhaap ban kar shareer ko bahut thanda karta hai, kyunki bhaap mein chhipi itni urja bahar nikal jaati hai. Iske ulat barf pighalne mein isse kaafi kam urja (80 cal/g) lagti hai, isliye wahan tapman ka badlav jaldi dikhta hai. Exam point: bhaap ki gupat ushma barf se bahut adhik (540 vs 80 cal/g) hoti hai, kyunki paani ke saare bandhan todne padte hain.

qe: What is an 'Adiabatic Wall' usually made of?
qh: 'रुद्धोष्म दीवार' आमतौर पर किसकी बनी होती है?
e: Adiabatic wall ko aise padarthon se banate hain jinme ushma-chaalakta tatha samvahan (pravah) bahut kam ho - jaise abhrak (asbestos), lakdi, kuch aadi (insulator) padarth; inhe hi sanyantrak (insulator) kehte hain kyunki ye heat ke bahav ko rok dete hain. Iske ulat tamba, silvar ya aluminium jaise dhaatu ushma ke achhe chaalak hote hain (mukta electron ke karan), isliye wo adiabatic wall ke liye bilkul anupukt hote hain. Bahari disha mein hawa ka jhokha ya pani ke thande bahav bhi wall ke ushma ke bahav ko rokne mein sahayak hote hain, isliye kilnn (thermos flask) mein double wall tatha vacuum ka istemal hota hai. Exam point: adiabatic wall aksar abhrak, lakdi ya kuch aadi padarthon ki bani hoti hai, kyunki ye ushma ke bahav ko rok dete hain.

qe: What is 'Temperature Gradient'?
qh: 'ताप प्रवणता' (Temperature Gradient) क्या है?
o: Change in temp with distance | दूरी के साथ तापमान में बदलाव ($dT/dx$)
e: Temperature gradient batati hai ki doori ke saath tapman kis dar se badalta hai - yani tapman-antar del T ko doori del x se bhaag dene se jo maan milta hai (dT/dx), wahi gradient kehlata hai. Yadi do binduon ka tapman-antar adhik ho par doori kam, to gradient bada hoga tatha ushma ka bahav bhi tez hoga (Fourier ke niyam ke anusar bahav ka maan gradient ke samanupati hota hai). Isi karan patli deewar par bada tapman-antar tatha moti deewar par kam antar - dono se banne wale tamam par kaam ka asar alag hota hai. Isliye gradient aayatan, dabav ya samveg se nahi, balki doori ke saath tapman ke badlav se juda hai. Exam point: temperature gradient doori ke saath tapman ke badlav (dT/dx) ko kehte hain; ye ushma ke bahav ki gati tay karta hai.

qe: What is the SI unit of 'Temperature Gradient'?
qh: 'ताप प्रवणता' का SI मात्रक क्या है?
e: Temperature gradient ek bhag-phal (distance ke saath tapman ka antar) hone ke karan iski ikai tapman ki ikai bhaagit doori ki ikai hoti hai, isliye SI mein kevin prati metre (K/m) likha jaata hai. Isi karan tapman-antar ka matrak K hai par gradient ka matrak K/m hota hai - inhe alag-alag likhna zaroori hai (jaise kisi deewar par 10 K/m ka gradient). Vastavik ganit mein K/cm ya degree C/m jaisa roop bhi istemal hota hai, kyunki chalne wale antar se matrak badal jaate hain. Isliye kevin (tapman ki ikai) ya J/K (entropy ki ikai) gradient ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: temperature gradient ki SI ikai K/m (kelvin prati metre) hoti hai, kyunki ye prati unit doori tapman ka badlav batata hai.

qe: What is 'Free Expansion' work done?
qh: 'मुक्त प्रसार' में किया गया कार्य क्या है?
e: Free expansion mein gas ek insulated bartan ke andar khali doosre bhaag mein failti hai - na bahari dabav ko todna padta hai na heat ka aadan-pradan hota hai, isliye kiya gaya kaam shunya hota hai (W = 0 tatha dQ = 0 hone se andaruni urja bhi sthir). Iske ulat, aam vistar mein piston ko dhakel kar kaam karana padta hai tatha usmein heat ka aadan-pradan zaroori hota hai. Isi karan free expansion asantulit (irreversible) kriya hoti hai tatha entropy badh jaati hai, chahe kaam shunya rahe. Isliye zero hi sahi jod hai - koi bahari rukawat na hone se kaam hota hi nahi. Exam point: free expansion mein kiya gaya kaam shunya hota hai (dQ = 0 tatha W = 0), kyunki gas bina kisi bahari rukawat ke apne aap failti hai.

qe: Which state of matter has 'Highest' thermal expansion coefficient?
qh: पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में 'उच्चतम' तापीय प्रसार गुणांक होता है?
e: Thos ke anu ek bandhi hui jali mein kas kar baithe hote hain, drav mein wo dheele tatha gas mein bilkul svatantra hote hain; tapman badhne par anuon ka kampan (ya gati) badhta hai isliye avastha ke hisaab se failav ka asar alag hota hai - gas ka aayatan sabse adhik badhta hai (isliye uske prasaar gunank ka maan sabse bada hota hai), thos ka sabse kam. Iska ganit ye hai ki gas ke anuon ke beech kamjor bandhan ke karan woh poore aayatan mein fail kar bheetar ka aayatan kaafi badha dete hain, jabki thos mein keval hulki jali kampan hoti hai. Isi karan gases ka thermal expansion coefficient sabse adhik hota hai. Exam point: gases ka thermal expansion coefficient sabse adhik hota hai, kyunki unke anu svatantra tatha kamjor bandhan wale hote hain (thos sabse kam failta hai).

qe: What is the unit of 'Boltzmann Constant'?
qh: 'बोल्ट्जमान' नियतांक का मात्रक क्या है?
e: Boltzmann constant k ek anu tatha ek mole ke beech ka pul hai; iska sutra R = Na x k hone se iski ikai R tatha Na ki ikaiyon ke anupat se nikal kar (J/K) banti hai. Isi k se kisi ek anu ki ausat urja ka maan k x T (prati azaadi-disha) nikalta hai tatha entropy ke aankdon mein bhi ye sankhya aati hai; iska maan 1.38 x 10^-23 J/K hota hai. Isliye ise 'mole-level' ke gas constant R (8.314 J/mol.K) se milaayein nahi - dono alag-alag star ke hain. Isliye J/K hi sahi matrak hai, J/mol.K ya K/J nahi. Exam point: Boltzmann constant ka matrak J/K (urja bhaagit tapman) hota hai, kyunki ye ek kan ki urja tatha tapman ka anupat batata hai (iski value 1.38 x 10^-23 J/K hoti hai).

qe: What is the 'Ideal Gas' equation for n moles?
qh: n मोल के लिए 'आदर्श गैस' समीकरण क्या है?
e: n mole gas ke liye aadarsh gas ka samikaran PV = nRT hota hai, jahan P dabav, V aayatan, n mole ki sankhya, R gas constant tatha T paramm tapman hota hai. Ye samikaran tik hi keval vaigyanik gases par nahi chalta tatha bahut si seemaon par ichhit lagta hai - jaise kam dabav tatha uchch tapman par (jahan anuon ki doori adhik hoti hai). Ismein tapman kelvin mein hi daalna padta hai tatha matrak sahi rakhne padte hain (P pascal tatha V m3, R = 8.314). Isliye PV = nRT hi sahi roop hai - isse milte-julte anya samikaran jaise Van der Waals (vastavik gas) alag roop hote hain. Exam point: n mole ke liye aadarsh gas samikaran PV = nRT hota hai, jismein T paramm kelvin tapman hota hai.

qe: What is 'Conduction' through 'Vacuum'?
qh: 'निर्वात' के माध्यम से 'चालन' क्या होता है?
e: Niravaat (vacuum) mein koi kan (anu ya electron) hi nahi hota, isliye ushma ke bahav ka koi saadhan nahi bachta - na conduction (kanon ki takraav) na samvahan (pravah) sambhav hai; keval vaikiran idhar-udhar ja sakti hai. Isi karan glass ke double-wall tatha bheetar ke vacuum se bane thermos flask mein chai der tak garm rehti hai, kyunki ushma ka raasta kaafi had tak band ho jaata hai. Isi dhaarna par vacuum flasks tatha dewar (cryogenic) bartan chalte hain. Isliye zero hi sahi jod hai - 'vahana' ya 'uchch samvahan' jaise jod niravaat mein sambhav hi nahi. Exam point: niravaat mein conduction zero hota hai (bina kan bahav sambhav nahi); ushma keval vaikiran se guzar sakti hai.

qe: What is 'Solar Radiation' speed?
qh: 'सौर विकिरण' की चाल क्या है?
o: Speed of light | प्रकाश की चाल ($3 \times 10^8 m/s$)
e: Surya se nikalne wali vaikiran vidyut-chumbakiya (electromagnetic) tarangon ke roop mein chalti hai - jismein koi dravyaman nahi hota - isliye ye bina kisi madhyam ke khaali space ko paar karke ham tak pahunchti hai, aur iski chaal 3 x 10^8 metre prati second (prakash ki chaal) hoti hai. Isi karan surya ki garmi 15 crore kilometre ki doori tatha khali space paar karke ham tak pahunchti hai, jahan na hawa hai na koi padarth. Isi ke aadhaar par widescreen tatha solar cell chalte hain, kyunki photon pakadkar bijli banti hai. Isliye koi dheemi chaal wala jod yahan sahi nahi - vaikiran ki chaal sabse adhik hoti hai. Exam point: solar radiation prakash ki chaal se chalti hai (lagbhag 3 x 10^8 m/s), kyunki ye vidyut-chumbakiya tarangein hain tatha inhe madhyam ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

qe: Which process is used in 'Refrigeration' to cool the cabinet?
qh: कैबिनेट को ठंडा करने के लिए 'रेफ्रिजरेशन' में किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग होता है?
o: Evaporation of refrigerant | रेफ्रिजरेंट का वाष्पीकरण
e: Refrigerator ke andar ka refrigerant gas compressor se dabkar tatha kondenser (pichli jali) se bahari hawva ko garmi dekar dravik rt hai; phir wo ek chhote chhidra (valve/capillary) se guzarta hai, jahan dabav ek dam girts hai - isliye drav refrigerant bahut thanda ho jaata hai tatha evaporator coil mein ubhal kar ushma sokh leta hai; isi karan cabinet thanda lagta hai. Iske baad gas phir compressor mein jaati hai, aur yahi chakra bandh nahi hote. Isliye 'sankochan (sanpeedan)' se thanda karna, 'vaikiran' ya 'samvahan' - ye vikalp refrigerator ke asli siddhant nahi hain. Exam point: refrigerator mein cabinet isliye thanda hota hai ki refrigerant drav ka evaporation ho kar ushma sokh leta hai (evaporation of refrigerant).

qe: What is 'Triple Point' of CO2 pressure?
qh: CO2 का 'त्रिक बिंदु' दाब क्या है?
e: CO2 ka triple point dabav lagbhag 5 kuchh atmosphere hota hai (lagbhag 5.11 atm tatha 216.6 K tapman) - is bindu par CO2 ki thos (sukhi barf), drav tatha gas teeno avasthaayein ek saath santulit rehti hain. Isse bada aakashiya vishesh hai: saadharan dabav (1 atm) par CO2 drav nahi hoti, seedha sublimation hoti hai, isliye sukhi barf (dry ice) 'pighalti' nahi balki seedha gas banti hai. Paani ka triple point (611.65 Pa) isse bahut kam hota hai, kyunki wahan dabav kam par hi teeno avasthayein milti hain. Exam point: CO2 ka triple point dabav lagbhag 5.11 atm hota hai; is bindu se niche CO2 drav nahi banti, seedha sublimation deti hai.

qe: Which law states 'Energy is equally distributed among degrees of freedom'?
qh: कौन सा नियम कहता है कि 'ऊर्जा स्वतंत्रता की कोटियों के बीच समान रूप से वितरित होती है'?
o: Law of Equipartition of Energy | ऊर्जा के सम-विभाजन का नियम
e: Kisi bhi gas ke anuon ki urja swatantrata ki koti mein barabar bat jaati hai (equipartition), isliye monoatomic gas (3 sthanantaran) ki ausat urja 3/2 kT tatha dwiparmaanvik (5 azaadi) ki 5/2 kT hoti hai - yahi niyam gases ki vishesh ushma (Cv, Cp) ke ganit ka aadhaar hai. Iske anusar sthir tapman par kisi bhi azaadi-disha mein lagne wali ausat urja 1/2 kT (urja ke aadhe hissa ka barabar) hoti hai, tatha ye urja tapman ke samanupati hoti hai, aayatan ya dabav par nirbhar nahi hoti. Isi karan gases ki ushma ki gannaa mein dof itna mahatvapurn hota hai (jaise kampan bhi shuru hote hi aankde badal jaate hain). Exam point: equipartition ka niyam kehta hai ki urja saare swatantrata koti mein barabar bat jaati hai (prati koti aadha kT); yahi gas ki vishesh ushma nikat karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Internal Energy' of 1 mole of monatomic gas?
qh: 1 मोल एक-परमाणुक गैस की 'आंतरिक ऊर्जा' क्या है?
e: Monoatomic gas ke atom keval sthanantaran (translation) karte hain tatha uske 3 azaadi-dishayein hoti hain; equipartition ke anusar prati azaadi 1/2 RT urja hoti hai, isliye 1 mole ki andaruni urja U = 3 x (1/2)RT = 3/2 RT hoti hai. Iska matlab ye hai ki U keval tapman par nirbhar karti hai tatha gas ke aayatan ya dabav se alag nahi hoti (aadarsh gas ke liye), isliye isothermal process mein U sthir rehti hai. Cp tatha Cv ke aankde isi aadhaar se nikalte hain (Cv = 3/2 R tatha Cp = 5/2 R). Isliye 3/2 RT hi sahi jod hai - anya gunank (jaise RT ya 5/2 RT) alag raashiyon ke liye hote hain. Exam point: 1 mole monoatomic gas ki andaruni urja 3/2 RT hoti hai, kyunki uske teen translation azaadi-dishayein hoti hain (prati azaadi 1/2 RT).

qe: What is 'Wien's Displacement Law' formula?
qh: 'वीन का विस्थापन नियम' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Wien ke displacement niyam ka samikaran lambda_max x T = b hota hai, jahan lambda_max us tapman par sabse tez (adhiktam) tarangdairdhya, T paramm tapman tatha b sthir gunank (0.29 cm.K) hai. Isse saaf hota hai ki adhiktam tarangdairdhya tapman ke badhne par ulta anupat mein chhoti hoti jaati hai, yani utsarg ka rang neele sire ki or sarak jaata hai; uchch tapman par dhaatu ka rang laal se peela tatha aage safed hota jaata hai. Iska prayog optical pyrometer tatha taaron ke tapman nikaalne mein hota hai. Isliye lambda_max x T = b hi sahi roop hai, anya jod (jaise lambda x T^4) alag niyam ke hote hain. Exam point: Wien ka displacement niyam lambda_max x T = b hota hai - tapman badhne par adhiktam tarangdairdhya ghatti hai (rang ka badlav isi se hota hai).

qe: What happens to the 'Freezing Point' of water when 'Pressure' is decreased?
qh: 'दाब' कम होने पर पानी के 'हिमांक' पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Paani ka ek khaas gun ye hai ki uske thos roop (barf) ka aayatan drav paani se adhik hota hai; isliye dabav ghatane par galaank badhta hai (Le-Chatelier ke anusar dabav kam hone par wahi disha badhti hai jismein aayatan adhik hota hai, yani paani ka banna). Bahut uchch dabav par ye asar saaf dikhta hai, jaise glacier ke neeche ki barf ka pighalna; par saadharan stithi mein iska asar chhota rehta hai. Iske ulat aise padarthon (jaise wax) mein dabav ghatane par galaank ghatta hai, kyunki wahan thos roop kam jagah leta hai. Exam point: paani ka freezing point dabav ghatane par badhta hai, kyunki barf drav paani se adhik jagah leti hai (isliye dabav kam karne par pighalna mushkil hota hai).

qe: Which state of matter has 'No' definite shape but definite volume?
qh: पदार्थ की किस अवस्था का 'कोई' निश्चित आकार नहीं होता लेकिन आयतन निश्चित होता है?
e: Drav (liquid) ke anu aapas mein bandhe rehte hain isliye uska aayatan nishchit rehta hai - bartan mein daalne par wo upar ki satah bana leta hai tatha nishchit jagah ghere rakhta hai; par unke bandhan itne dheele hote hain ki wo beh kar apna aakaar badal sakte hain, isliye drav ka koi nishchit aakaar (shape) nahi hota. Yahi karan hai ki paani bottle ka aakaar leta hai par chhote mole mein bhi apna nishchit aayatan banaye rakhta hai. Gas ka na aakaar na aayatan nishchit hota hai, tatha thos ka dono nishchit hota hai - isliye teen avasthaon ko pehchaanne ka ye aasaan tareeka hai. Exam point: drav avastha mein nishchit aakaar nahi par nishchit aayatan hota hai, kyunki uske anu beh sakte hain par paas-paas bandhe rehte hain.

qe: What does the 'a' in Van der Waals equation $[P + a/V^2][V - b] = RT$ represent?
qh: वैन डर वाल्स समीकरण में 'a' क्या दर्शाता है?
e: Van der Waals samikaran mein 'a' ka gunank anuon ke beech ke aakarshan bal (intermolecular forces of attraction) ka maap hota hai; ye dabav ke saath judta hai, kyunki asli gas ke anu ek doosre ko kheench kar deewar par kam zabardasti daalte hain - isliye samikaran mein (P + a/V^2) likha jaata hai. Adhik 'a' ka matlab anuon mein zyada aakarshan tatha aasaani se drav banne wali gas (jaise CO2 ka a bada hota hai). 'b' ka gunank anuon ke nija aayatan (co-volume) ka maap hota hai, isliye dono alag-alag gun hain tatha inhe milaayein nahi. Exam point: Van der Waals samikaran ka 'a' anuon ke aakarshan bal (intermolecular force) ko batata hai, jabki 'b' unke aayatan (co-volume) ko batata hai.

qe: What does the 'b' in Van der Waals equation represent?
qh: वैन डर वाल्स समीकरण में 'b' क्या दर्शाता है?
e: Van der Waals samikaran mein 'b' ka gunank anuon ke nija aayatan tatha unke bheetar ki khaali jagah (effective size/co-volume) ka maap hota hai - ye aayatan ke saath judta hai isliye (V - b) likha jaata hai, kyunki gas ke anuon ko chalne ke liye upalabdh khaali jagah V se b kam hoti hai. Iski ikai m3/mol hoti hai tatha iska maan bade anuon (jaise CO2) ke liye adhik hota hai. Iske ulat 'a' ka gunank aakarshan bal batata hai - dono gun alag-alag hote hain, inhe ek jaisa na samjhein. Exam point: is samikaran ka 'b' anuon ke prabhavi aayatan (co-volume) ko batata hai, kyunki gas ke liye upalabdh jagah V se b kam hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Efficiency' of a heat engine that does 500J of work and absorbs 2000J of heat?
qh: एक इंजन की 'दक्षता' क्या होगी जो 500J कार्य करता है और 2000J ऊष्मा सोखता है?
e: Efficiency ka sutra eta = nikaala gaya kaam / di gai heat = W/Q1 hota hai; is prashn mein W = 500 joule tatha Q1 = 2000 joule hai, isliye eta = 500/2000 = 0.25 yani 25% ban jaata hai. Iska arth hai ki di gai heat ka chautha hissa kaam mein baadal tatha baaki 1500 joule heat sink ko chali gayi (isliye pratishat ka hisaab lagana zaroori hai, dono aankdon ko jodna nahi). Isi dhaarna se Carnot ki seema tatha vastavik engine ki tulna ki jaati hai. Isliye 25% hi sahi jod hai - 500 ya 2000 jaise aankde kaam tatha heat ke hain, efficiency ke nahi. Exam point: efficiency = W/Q1 = 500/2000 = 25%; yani di gai heat ka chautha hissa hi kaam mein badalta hai.

qe: What is the 'Temperature of Inversion' ($T_i$) in Joule-Thomson effect?
qh: जूल-थॉमसन प्रभाव में 'व्युत्क्रमण तापमान' ($T_i$) क्या है?
