e: Joule-Thomson asar mein gunank tapman ke saath badalta hai tatha ek aise tapman par shunya ho jaata hai jise inversion temperature (Ti) kehte hain; Van der Waals gunankon ki sahayata se iska maan 2a/Rb hota hai. Is tapman se niche aam gases thandi hoti hain (asli thandak hoti hai) tatha isse upar wo garam ho jaati hain - isliye hydrogen tatha helium ko pehle isse niche thanda karna padta hai, tab wo thandak deti hain. Isi karan Ti ka ganit drav-gases banane wale plants mein bahut mahatvapurn hai. Exam point: inversion temperature Ti = 2a/Rb hoti hai; isse niche gas thandi tatha isse upar garam hoti hai (isi liye hydrogen-helium ko pehle thanda karna padta hai).

qe: Which thermodynamic process is represented by the 'Area' of a P-V diagram?
qh: P-V आरेख का 'क्षेत्रफल' किस ऊष्मागतिक प्रक्रिया को दर्शाता है?
o: Work Done | किया गया कार्य (Work Done)
e: P-V diagram par chalti hui kriya ke niche ka kshetrafal (area) kiya gaya kaam (work done) batata hai - kyunki kaam = P x dV hota hai tatha aayatan ke saath dabav ka jod (integration) chhoti-chhoti pattiyon ka jod hota hai, isliye graph ke niche ka area seedha kaam ke barabar hota hai. Yadi kriya sankochan ki or badhe to kaam rin (negative) tatha failav mein dhan hota hai - yani area ka chinh (sign) bhi maayne rakhta hai. Chakra (cycle) ke liye chakra ke bheetar ka area net kaam deta hai. Isliye 'work done' hi sahi jod hai - tapman ya entropy ke aankde is graph se seedha nahi nikalte. Exam point: P-V diagram ke area se kiya gaya kaam nikaala jaata hai, isliye area ka maan hi kaam batata hai.

qe: What is a 'Heat Pump' primarily used for?
qh: 'हीट पंप' का मुख्य उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
o: Heating a space | किसी स्थान को गर्म करने के लिए
e: Heat pump ka mukhya kaam kisi kamre ya sthan ko garam karna hota hai - ye bahari hawva ya zameen se ushma nikaal kar (kam tapman par bhi) ushe andar ke kamre mein daalta hai, isliye sardi mein ghar garam rakhne ke liye iska upyog hota hai. Iska coefficient of performance 3-4 tak ho sakta hai, yani ek unit bijli ke badle teen-char unit ushma kamre mein pahunchti hai, isliye ye heater se adhik kushal maana jaata hai. Refrigerator bhi wahi yantra hai par uska uddeshya khana thanda rakhna hota hai (kamre se ushma bahar fekna), isliye dono mein antar uddeshya ka hai. Exam point: heat pump ka mukhya kaam kisi sthan ko garam karna hota hai (bahar se ushma sokhkar andar daalna), isliye sardi mein iska istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Boiling Point' of liquid Hydrogen approximately?
qh: तरल हाइड्रोजन का 'क्वथनांक' लगभग क्या है?
e: Hydrogen ka boiling point lagbhag 20 kelvin (-253 degree C) hota hai - is tapman par ye gas drav (liquid) ban jaati hai, isliye ise drav hydrogen kehte hain tatha antariksh (rocket) engines mein indhan ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Drav banane ke liye pehle ise Joule-Thomson kriya ke zariye bahut thanda karna padta hai, kyunki iska inversion temperature khud bahut kam hota hai. Iske ulat oxygen ka lagbhag 90 K tatha nitrogen ka 77 K hota hai, isliye wo aasaani se drav hote hain. Exam point: liquid hydrogen ka boiling point lagbhag 20 kelvin hota hai; itna kam tapman hone ke karan ushe sambhalna (storage karna) mushkil hota hai.

qe: What is 'Molar Heat Capacity' at constant volume ($C_v$) for a Diatomic gas?
qh: द्वि-परमाणुक गैस के लिए स्थिर आयतन पर 'मोलर ऊष्मा क्षमता' ($C_v$) क्या है?
e: Dwiparmaanvik gas (jaise H2, N2, O2) ke do atom ek aksh par judte hain, isliye unke paas 3 sthanantaran tatha 2 ghoornan - kul 5 azaadi-dishayein hoti hain; equipartition ke anusar sthir aayatan par molar ushma (5/2)R tatha sthir dabav par (7/2)R hoti hai, isliye gamma = 1.4 hota hai. Isi karan aam hawva (oxygen-nitrogen wali) ka gamma lagbhag 1.4 milta hai, jo bahut saara ganit aasaan kar deta hai. Kam tapman par kampan (vibration) nahi hota, isliye ye aankde sahi baithte hain; bahut uchch tapman par ye maan badal sakta hai. Isliye 5/2 R hi sahi jod hai, 3/2 R monoatomic gas ka hota hai. Exam point: dwiparmaanvik gas ke liye sthir aayatan par molar ushma Cv = 5/2 R hoti hai, kyunki uske 5 azaadi-dishayein (3 translation + 2 rotation) hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Adiabatic Lapse Rate' related to?
qh: 'रुद्धोष्म ह्रास दर' (Adiabatic Lapse Rate) किससे संबंधित है?
o: Atmospheric temperature change with height | ऊंचाई के साथ वायुमंडलीय तापमान में बदलाव
e: Vayumandal mein ucchai badhne ke saath hawva ka dabav ghatta hai tatha wo fail jaati hai - failav mein kaam karne tatha vaikiran se ushma nikalne se uske tapman mein girti hoti hai; ye dar (rate) hi 'adiabatic lapse rate' kehlati hai (saadharan taur par lagbhag 6.5 degree C prati kilometre). Ye dar mausam, badal tatha pahadi sthalon ke tapman ko samajhne ke liye bahut zaroori hai - isi se pata chalta hai ki ucch pahadi sthalon par tapman kam kyun hota hai. Isliye ye ek 'tapman ka badlav dar' hai, kisi pind ka ushma-gunank nahi. Exam point: adiabatic lapse rate vayumandal mein ucchai ke saath tapman ke badlav ki dar ko kehti hai (lagbhag 6.5 degree C prati kilometre).

qe: What is the 'Thermal Conductivity' of Copper in SI units approximately?
qh: SI मात्रक में तांबे की 'तापीय चालकता' लगभग कितनी है?
e: Copper ki ushma-chaalakta SI matrakon mein lagbhag 400 W/m.K hoti hai - ye dhaatuon mein sabse adhik aankdon mein se ek hai (silver ke baad, jo lagbhag 429 hoti hai), kyunki uske bahari kosh mein bahut se mukta electron chalte hain. Isi gun ke karan tamba bijli ke taar, cooker, bhagoun ke niche tatha heat exchanger mein istemal hota hai. Iske ulat lakdi (lagbhag 0.15), abhrak (0.1) tatha thermos (0.04) jaise padarthon ke aankde bahut kam hote hain. Isliye yahan lagbhag 400 hi sahi hai, 0.4 ya 4 jaise aankde bahut kam hote hain. Exam point: copper ki ushma-chaalakta ka maan lagbhag 400 W/m.K hota hai - isi karan ye ushma ka achha chaalak tatha heat exchange yantron ke liye upyukt hota hai.

qe: What is 'Regelation' in ice used for in sports?
qh: खेलों में बर्फ में 'पुनर्हिमायन' का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
e: Regelation ke anusar dabav padne wali barf pighal kar chikni parat bana deti hai tatha dabav hatte hi phir jam jaati hai; skating ke patle blade ki dhaar par bada dabav padta hai, isliye wahan barf pighalti hai tatha skater aasaani se sarakta hai. Isi kriya se blade ka naas bhi jaldi nahi hota, kyunki peeche ki barf phir se jama jaati hai (isliye ise pichhe se bhar jaane wala gun bhi kehte hain). Iska istemal barf hatiyaron tatha thandi sthalon ki khel-pratiyogitaon mein saaf dikhta hai. Exam point: ice skating mein regelation ka fayda hota hai - blade ke dabav se barf pighalti hai tatha chikni parat banti hai, isliye skater aasaani se sarakta hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Pressure' of a gas in an 'Isochoric' heating?
qh: 'सम-आयतनिक' तापन में गैस के 'दाब' का क्या होता है?
e: Isochoric (sthir aayatan) heating mein gas ka aayatan sthir rehta hai, isliye ushe fail kar kaam karne ki jagah nahi milti - poori di gai heat aantarik urja mein badal jaati hai. Aadarsh gas ke liye U tapman par nirbhar karti hai, isliye tapman badhne par dabav bhi badhta hai; isi karan bandh bartan ya cylinder ko aag par rakhne par uska dabav khatarnaak taur par badh jaata hai. Ye sambandh sthir aayatan wale gas niyam se saaf hota hai (P/T = sthir, aayatan na badle to dabav tapman ke saath badhta hai). Exam point: isochoric heating mein gas ka dabav badhta hai, kyunki aayatan sthir rehne se di gai heat poori tarah tapman tatha dabav badha deti hai.

qe: What is the 'Gamma' ($\gamma$) value for a Triatomic (non-linear) gas like $H_2O$?
qh: $H_2O$ जैसी त्रि-परमाणुक (अ-रैखीय) गैस के लिए 'गामा' ($\gamma$) का मान क्या है?
e: Jab triatomic gas ke teen atom ek seedhi line mein na hokar mudkar lage hote hain (jaise paani ki bhaap ke anu), to uske paas teen sthanantaran (translation) tatha teen ghoornan (rotation) - kul chhah azaadi-dishayein hoti hain; equipartition ke hisaab se uski garmi-kshamata na badalte aayatan par 3R tatha na badalte dabav par 4R nikal jaati hai, isliye gamma = 4/3 yani lagbhag 1.33 banta hai. Iske ulat linear triatomic (CO2) ka gamma 1.4 tatha monoatomic ka 1.67 hota hai, isliye wo aankde bhaap ke liye sahi nahi. Isi karan bhaap se chalne wale system mein ya bhaap ke tapman-ganit mein ye anupat yaad rakha jaata hai. Exam point: mudkar lage (non-linear) triatomic anu jaise H2O ki bhaap ka gamma lagbhag 1.33 (4/3) hota hai, kyunki uske chhah azaadi-dishayein hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Black Body' radiation often called?
qh: 'कृष्ण पिंड' विकिरण को अक्सर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Kaale pind (black body) ki kalpana aadarsh hai; vyavhar mein aise pind ko ek bandh kotar (cavity) ke chhote chhidra se banaya jaata hai - bahar se aane wali vaikiran kotar ke andar baar-baar paravartit tatha sokhi jaati hai tatha chhidra se nikalne wali vaikiran ka spectrum lagbhag poora kaale pind jaisa hota hai, isliye ise cavity radiation kehte hain. Isi karan vaigyanik bandh kotar ke andar ke tapman par nikalne wali vaikiran ka adhyayan karte hain, jisse Planck tatha Wien ke niyam bane. Isse pata chalta hai ki kaale pind ka koi nishchit rang nahi hota - uski vaikiran keval tapman par nirbhar karti hai. Exam point: black body ki vaikiran ko cavity radiation kehte hain, kyunki bandh kotar ke chhidra se nikalne wali vaikiran ka vyavhaar aadarsh kaale pind jaisa hota hai.
